  function earthlinePathDistanceFast15770(a,b,currentBestM=Infinity){
    const ma=earthlinePathMetrics15770(a),mb=earthlinePathMetrics15770(b);
    if(!ma||!mb)return Infinity;
    const cell=Math.max(.001,M.cellM||1);
    const dx=ma.maxX<mb.minX?mb.minX-ma.maxX:(mb.maxX<ma.minX?ma.minX-mb.maxX:0);
    const dy=ma.maxY<mb.minY?mb.minY-ma.maxY:(mb.maxY<ma.minY?ma.minY-mb.maxY:0);
    const lowerM=Math.hypot(dx,dy)*cell;
    if(lowerM>=currentBestM)return Infinity;
    let bestSq=Number.isFinite(currentBestM)?Math.pow(currentBestM/cell,2):Infinity;
    for(const p of ma.pts)for(const q of mb.pts){
      const px=p[0]-q[0],py=p[1]-q[1],d2=px*px+py*py;
      if(d2<bestSq)bestSq=d2;
    }
    return Number.isFinite(bestSq)?Math.sqrt(bestSq)*cell:Infinity;
  }

  function earthlineDeterministicSpacingSample15770(list,maxCount=64){

  }

  function spacingStats(swales){
    const list=(swales||[]).filter(s=>s&&s.pts&&s.pts.length>1);
    const sample=earthlineDeterministicSpacingSample15770(list,64);
    const nearest=[];
    for(const subject of sample){
      let best=Infinity;
      for(const other of list){

        if(subject.bandKey!=null&&other.bandKey!=null&&subject.bandKey===other.bandKey)continue;
        if(earthlineBBoxGapM15770(subject,other)>=best)continue;
        const d=earthlinePathDistanceFast15770(subject,other,best);
        if(d<best)best=d;
      }
      if(Number.isFinite(best))nearest.push(best);
    }
    nearest.sort((a,b)=>a-b);
    return {
      populationCount:list.length,
      sampleCount:nearest.length,
      sampled:list.length>sample.length,
      medianM:median(nearest),
      minM:nearest[0]||0,maxM:nearest[nearest.length-1]||0,
      meanM:nearest.length?nearest.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/nearest.length:0
    };
  }

  function gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,gx,gy){
    const dxM=(gx-GW/2)*cellM,dyM=(gy-GH/2)*cellM;
    return [tile.lng+dxM/metersPerLng(tile.lat),tile.lat-dyM/111320];
  }
  function featureKey(f){
    const c=f&&f.geometry&&f.geometry.coordinates;
    if(!c)return Math.random().toString();
    let p=null;
    if(f.geometry.type==="LineString"&&c.length)p=c[Math.floor(c.length/2)];
    else if(f.geometry.type==="Polygon"&&c[0]&&c[0].length)p=c[0][Math.floor(c[0].length/2)];
    return p?p.map(v=>Number(v).toFixed(5)).join("|"):JSON.stringify(c).slice(0,120);
  }
  function appendUnique(target,features){
    const keys=new Set(target.map(featureKey));
    for(const f of (features||[])){const k=featureKey(f);if(keys.has(k))continue;keys.add(k);target.push(f);}
  }
  function regionalOpportunitySwales15773(tile,cellM,tileIndex,opportunity){
    const features=[],raw=[],candidates=[];
    const maxAcc=Math.max(2,Number(M.maxAcc||2));
    const channelThreshold=Math.max(3,streamThreshold()*3.0);

    for(let y=3;y<GH-3;y+=3)for(let x=3;x<GW-3;x+=3){
      const i=idx(x,y);
      if(!M.inP[i]||M.pond[i]||(M.noBuildMask&&M.noBuildMask[i]))continue;
      if((M.acc[i]||0)>=channelThreshold)continue;
      const sp=slopePct(x,y);
      if(sp<2.2||sp>6.5)continue;
      const slopeFit=Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(sp-3.5)/3.0);
      const runoff=Math.log1p(M.acc[i]||1)/Math.log1p(maxAcc);
      const open=(M.canopyMask&&M.canopyMask[i])?0.25:1;
      const score=.50*slopeFit+.34*runoff+.16*open;
      candidates.push({x,y,sp,score,L:hAt(x,y)});
    }
    candidates.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);

    const acceptedLevels=[];
    for(const c of candidates){
      if(features.length>=4)break;
      if(acceptedLevels.some(L=>Math.abs(L-c.L)<Math.max(.25,cellM*.018)))continue;

      const pts=traceLevelContour(c.x,c.y,c.L,12,Math.max(.12,cellM*.02));
      if(!pts||pts.length<4)continue;

      const split=earthlineSplitUsableSegments(pts,12);
      let bestSeg=null,bestLen=0;
      for(const seg of (split||[])){
        const len=earthlineSegmentLengthM(seg);
        if(len>bestLen){bestLen=len;bestSeg=seg;}
      }
      if(!bestSeg||bestLen<Math.max(35,cellM*3))continue;

      const display=earthlineNaturalContourDisplay(bestSeg);
      const safeParts=earthlineFinalSafeSegments15771(display,12);
      for(const safe of safeParts){
        const lenM=earthlinePathLengthM(safe);
        if(!safe||safe.length<3||lenM<Math.max(30,cellM*2.5))continue;
        const coords=safe.map(p=>gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,p[0],p[1]));
        const id="O"+tileIndex+"-"+(features.length+1);
        const score=Math.round(100*(.65*c.score+.35*Math.min(1,Number(opportunity&&opportunity.score||0)/100)));
        features.push({
          type:"Feature",
          properties:{
            id,tile:tileIndex,score,
            scale:"regional-opportunity",
            constructionReady:false,
            label:"GRADED SWALE OPPORTUNITY"
          },
          geometry:{type:"LineString",coordinates:coords}
        });
        raw.push({
          tile:tileIndex,id,coords,lenM,capCells:Math.max(1,M.acc[idx(Math.round(c.x),Math.round(c.y))]||1),
          score,bandKey:String(tileIndex)+"|O"+acceptedLevels.length,
          absLevelM:Number((M.loc&&M.loc.elevM)||0)+c.L
        });
        acceptedLevels.push(c.L);
        break;
      }
    }
    return {features,raw};
  }

  function flowDataForTile(tile,cellM,tileIndex){
    const features=[],thr=Math.max(2,streamThreshold()*.78),active=new Uint8Array(N),up=new Uint8Array(N);
    for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){const i=idx(x,y);if(M.acc[i]>=thr&&M.inP[i])active[i]=1;}
    for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
      const i=idx(x,y);if(!active[i]||M.dir[i]<0)continue;
      const nx=x+D8X[M.dir[i]],ny=y+D8Y[M.dir[i]];
      if(nx>=0&&ny>=0&&nx<GW&&ny<GH&&active[idx(nx,ny)]&&up[idx(nx,ny)]<255)up[idx(nx,ny)]++;
    }
    for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
      const start=idx(x,y);if(!active[start]||up[start]===1||M.dir[start]<0)continue;
      let cx=x,cy=y,ci=start,maxA=M.acc[start],guard=0;const pts=[[x+.5,y+.5]];
      while(guard++<700){
        const d=M.dir[ci];if(d<0)break;const nx=cx+D8X[d],ny=cy+D8Y[d];
        if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)break;const ni=idx(nx,ny);if(!active[ni])break;
        cx=nx;cy=ny;ci=ni;maxA=Math.max(maxA,M.acc[ni]);pts.push([cx+.5,cy+.5]);if(up[ci]!==1)break;
      }
      if(pts.length<3)continue;
      const strength=clampN(Math.log1p(maxA/thr)/Math.log1p(Math.max(2,M.maxAcc/thr)),0,1);
      features.push({type:"Feature",properties:{tile:tileIndex,strength:Number(strength.toFixed(4))},geometry:{type:"LineString",coordinates:pts.map(p=>gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,p[0],p[1]))}});
    }
    return features;
  }

  function earthlineOpportunityPointClear15777(px,py){
    const gx=Math.round(px),gy=Math.round(py);
    if(!earthlinePathPointUsable(gx,gy,8))return false;
    const channelThreshold=Math.max(3,streamThreshold()*2.45);
    const radius=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(18/Math.max(.5,Number(M.cellM||1))));
    for(let oy=-radius;oy<=radius;oy++)for(let ox=-radius;ox<=radius;ox++){
      const x=gx+ox,y=gy+oy;
      if(x<0||y<0||x>=GW||y>=GH)continue;
      const i=idx(x,y);
      if((M.noBuildMask&&M.noBuildMask[i])||(M.pond&&M.pond[i]))return false;
      if(M.acc&&M.acc[i]>=channelThreshold)return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  function earthlineEvaluateOpportunityPath15777(path,targetH,cellM,candidate){
    if(!path||path.length<5)return null;
    let slopeSum=0,maxSlope=0,elevErrSum=0,maxElevErr=0,samples=0;
    const step=Math.max(1,Math.floor(path.length/22));

    for(let i=0;i<path.length;i+=step){
      const p=path[i];
      if(!earthlineOpportunityPointClear15777(p[0],p[1]))return null;
      const sp=slopePct(Math.round(p[0]),Math.round(p[1]));
      const err=Math.abs(hAt(p[0],p[1])-targetH);
      slopeSum+=sp;maxSlope=Math.max(maxSlope,sp);
      elevErrSum+=err;maxElevErr=Math.max(maxElevErr,err);
      samples++;
    }
    if(!samples)return null;

    const lengthM=earthlinePathLengthM(path);
    const first=path[0],last=path[path.length-1];
    const chordM=Math.hypot(last[0]-first[0],last[1]-first[1])*Math.max(.001,cellM);
    const tortuosity=lengthM/Math.max(1,chordM);
    const meanSlope=slopeSum/samples;
    const meanElevError=elevErrSum/samples;
    const allowedElevError=Math.max(.45,Math.min(2.2,cellM*.035));

    if(meanSlope<2.55||meanSlope>4.85)return null;
    if(maxSlope>7.5)return null;
    if(maxElevErr>allowedElevError*1.8)return null;
    if(tortuosity>2.15)return null;
    if(lengthM<Math.max(55,cellM*3.5)||lengthM>950)return null;

    const slopeQuality=Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(meanSlope-3.55)/1.45);
    const contourQuality=Math.max(0,1-meanElevError/allowedElevError);
    const lengthQuality=Math.min(1,lengthM/180)*Math.min(1,650/Math.max(1,lengthM));
    const shapeQuality=Math.max(0,1-(tortuosity-1)/1.15);
    const quality=Math.round(100*(
      .38*slopeQuality+
      .31*contourQuality+
      .18*lengthQuality+
      .13*shapeQuality
    ));

    return {
      path,lengthM,
      meanSlope:Number(meanSlope.toFixed(2)),
      maxSlope:Number(maxSlope.toFixed(2)),
      meanElevError:Number(meanElevError.toFixed(2)),
      maxElevError:Number(maxElevErr.toFixed(2)),
      tortuosity:Number(tortuosity.toFixed(2)),
      quality
    };
  }

  function opportunityContourPath15777(tile,cellM,candidate){
    const targetH=candidate.levelH;
    const traced=traceLevelContour(
      candidate.gx,candidate.gy,targetH,8,
      Math.max(.10,Math.min(1.5,cellM*.018))
    );
    if(!traced||traced.length<5)return null;

    const split=earthlineSplitUsableSegments(traced,8);
    const evaluated=[];
    for(const seg of (split||[])){
      if(!seg||seg.length<5)continue;
      const smoothed=earthlineNaturalContourDisplay(seg);
      for(const safe of earthlineFinalSafeSegments15771(smoothed,8)){
        const result=earthlineEvaluateOpportunityPath15777(
          safe,targetH,cellM,candidate
        );
        if(result)evaluated.push(result);
      }
    }
    evaluated.sort((a,b)=>
      (b.quality-a.quality) ||
      (b.lengthM-a.lengthM)
    );
    const best=evaluated[0];
    if(!best)return null;

    return {
      coords:best.path.map(p=>gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,p[0],p[1])),
      metrics:best
    };
  }

      if(sp>=2.6&&sp<=5.0)workable++;
      if(M.noBuildMask&&M.noBuildMask[i])noBuild++;
      if(M.canopyMask&&M.canopyMask[i])canopy++;

      if(runoff<.07)continue;

        .48*slopeFit+
        .30*runoff+
        .10*open+
        .12*channelSetback
      ));

        baseScore,runoff:Number(runoff.toFixed(3)),open
      });
    }

        .32*corridorResult.metrics.quality
      );

      const confidence=(
        finalScore>=80 &&
        corridorResult.metrics.quality>=76 &&
        corridorResult.metrics.maxElevError<=1.6
      )?"High":(
        finalScore>=65 &&
        corridorResult.metrics.quality>=62
      )?"Moderate":"Preliminary";

      });
    }

        M.rechargeStats.highVeryHighPct!=null

      ?Math.round(hotspots.slice(0,4).reduce((a,h)=>a+h.score,0)/Math.min(4,hotspots.length))
      :0;

      score:tileScore,

  function rebuildRegionalGrades15772(){

    };

  function contourNiceStep15775(raw){
    const power=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(Math.max(.001,raw))));
    const n=raw/power;

  function contourDataForTile15772(tile,cellM,tileIndex){
    const features=[];
    let minH=Infinity,maxH=-Infinity;
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
      if(!M.inP[i])continue;
      const h=Number(M.h[i]);
      if(!Number.isFinite(h))continue;
      minH=Math.min(minH,h);maxH=Math.max(maxH,h);
    }
    if(!Number.isFinite(minH)||!Number.isFinite(maxH)||maxH-minH<1)return features;

    const range=maxH-minH;
    const step=contourNiceStep15775(range/6);
    const first=Math.ceil(minH/step)*step;
    let levelIndex=0;

    for(let L=first;L<maxH&&levelIndex<7;L+=step,levelIndex++){
      const lines=[];
      let labelCoord=null;

      const cross=(a,b)=>(
        (a<=L&&b>L)||(a>L&&b<=L)
      );
      const interp=(a,b)=>{
        const d=b-a;
        return Math.abs(d)<1e-9?.5:(L-a)/d;
      };

      for(let y=0;y<GH-1;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW-1;x++){
        const h00=Number(M.h[idx(x,y)]);
        const h10=Number(M.h[idx(x+1,y)]);
        const h01=Number(M.h[idx(x,y+1)]);
        const h11=Number(M.h[idx(x+1,y+1)]);
        if(!Number.isFinite(h00)||!Number.isFinite(h10)||!Number.isFinite(h01)||!Number.isFinite(h11))continue;

        const pts=[];
        if(cross(h00,h10))pts.push([x+interp(h00,h10),y]);
        if(cross(h10,h11))pts.push([x+1,y+interp(h10,h11)]);
        if(cross(h01,h11))pts.push([x+interp(h01,h11),y+1]);
        if(cross(h00,h01))pts.push([x,y+interp(h00,h01)]);

        if(pts.length===2){
          const a=gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
          const b=gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,pts[1][0],pts[1][1]);
          lines.push([a,b]);
        }else if(pts.length===4){
          const a=gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
          const b=gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,pts[1][0],pts[1][1]);
          const c=gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,pts[2][0],pts[2][1]);
          const d=gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,pts[3][0],pts[3][1]);
          lines.push([a,b],[c,d]);
        }

        if(lines.length>=360)break;
      }

      if(!lines.length)continue;
      const major=levelIndex%2===0;
      features.push({
        type:"Feature",
        properties:{tile:tileIndex,major,elevM:Math.round(Number((M.loc&&M.loc.elevM)||0)+L)},
        geometry:{type:"MultiLineString",coordinates:lines}
      });

      if(major){
        const seg=lines[Math.floor(lines.length/2)];
        labelCoord=[(seg[0][0]+seg[1][0])/2,(seg[0][1]+seg[1][1])/2];
        const absM=Math.round(Number((M.loc&&M.loc.elevM)||0)+L);
        features.push({
          type:"Feature",
          properties:{tile:tileIndex,major:true,elevM:absM,label:absM.toLocaleString()+" m"},
          geometry:{type:"Point",coordinates:labelCoord}
        });
      }
    }
    return features;
  }

  function rawSpacingSamples(raw){

    const raw=(values||[]).slice(0,5).map(v=>Math.max(0,Number(v)||0));
    while(raw.length<5)raw.push(0);
    let total=raw.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
    if(total<=0){raw[2]=100;total=100;}
    const p=raw.map(v=>Number((v/total*100).toFixed(1)));
    const diff=Number((100-p.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)).toFixed(1));
    p[2]=Number((p[2]+diff).toFixed(1));
    return p;
  }
  function donutObjects15778(p){
    const names=["Very High","High","Moderate","Low","Very Low"],colors=["#e53935","#fb8c00","#fdd835","#43a047","#1e88e5"];
    return normalizeDistribution15778(p).map((v,i)=>({n:names[i],c:colors[i],p:v}));
  }
  function snapshotTile15778(site,opportunity){
    let sum=0,analysisCells=0,finiteElevationCells=0,noBuild=0;
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++)if(M.inP[i]){
      analysisCells++;if(Number.isFinite(Number(M.h[i]))){sum+=Number(M.h[i]);finiteElevationCells++;}
      if(M.noBuildMask&&M.noBuildMask[i])noBuild++;
    }
    const countryCode=String(site.countryCode||earthlineCountryCode(site)||"").toLowerCase().slice(0,2);
    const ctx={analysisCells,finiteElevationCells,precipIn:Number(site.precipIn||0),countryCode};
    const current=(M.donut||[]).map(x=>Number(x&&x.p||0));
    const dist=normalizeDistribution15778(current.length?current:[0,0,100,0,0]);
    const meanElevationM=Number(site.elevM||0)+(finiteElevationCells?sum/finiteElevationCells:0);
    return {
      analysisCells,finiteElevationCells,meanElevationM,meanElevationFt:meanElevationM*3.28084,
      rechargeDistribution:dist,rechargeScore:Number((dist[0]+dist[1]).toFixed(1)),
      rechargeBasis:(M.rechargeStats&&M.rechargeStats.analyzedCells)?"Modeled cell distribution":"Modeled distribution; detailed source metadata unavailable",
      runoffCoefficient:Number(site.runC||.35),precipIn:Number(site.precipIn||30),
      noBuildPct:analysisCells?Number((noBuild/analysisCells*100).toFixed(1)):0,
      exclusions:Object.assign({},M.vectorNoBuildCoverage||{}),
      confidence:confidenceV0FromCurrent15778(ctx),countryCode,opportunity
    };
  }
  function aggregateRegional15778(){
    const tiles=(state.tileStats||[]).filter(t=>t&&t.status==="complete"&&t.snapshot);
    const weights=tiles.map(t=>Math.max(1,Number(t.snapshot.analysisCells||1)));
    const totalWeight=weights.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)||1;
    const dist=[0,0,0,0,0];
    let elev=0,runC=0,precip=0,noBuild=0,confidence=0;
    for(let k=0;k<tiles.length;k++){
      const s=tiles[k].snapshot,w=weights[k];
      for(let i=0;i<5;i++)dist[i]+=Number(s.rechargeDistribution[i]||0)*w;
      elev+=Number(s.meanElevationM||0)*w;runC+=Number(s.runoffCoefficient||0)*w;
      precip+=Number(s.precipIn||0)*w;noBuild+=Number(s.noBuildPct||0)*w;
      confidence+=Number(s.confidence&&s.confidence.score||0)*w;
    }
    const normalized=normalizeDistribution15778(dist.map(v=>v/totalWeight));
    const countryCode=String((state.parent&&state.parent.countryCode)||earthlineCountryCode(state.parent||{})||"").toLowerCase().slice(0,2);
    const confidenceComponents={};
    for(const key of Object.keys(CONFIDENCE_WEIGHTS_15778)){
      let weighted=0,bases=[];
      for(let k=0;k<tiles.length;k++){
        const c=tiles[k].snapshot.confidence.components[key],w=weights[k];
        weighted+=Number(c&&c.score||0)*w;if(c&&c.basis&&!bases.includes(c.basis))bases.push(c.basis);
      }
      confidenceComponents[key]={score:Number((weighted/totalWeight).toFixed(1)),basis:bases.slice(0,3).join(" | ")};
    }
    const corridorFeatures=(state.opportunityLines&&state.opportunityLines.features)||[];
    const corridorLengthM=corridorFeatures.reduce((sum,f)=>sum+lineLengthM(f.geometry&&f.geometry.coordinates||[]),0);
    const ranked=state.rankedOpportunities||[];
    const gradeA=ranked.filter(x=>x.grade==="A").length,gradeB=ranked.filter(x=>x.grade==="B").length;
    const totGph=tiles.reduce((a,t)=>a+Number(t.totGph||0),0),outGph=tiles.reduce((a,t)=>a+Number(t.outGph||0),0);
    return {
      mode:"regional",completedTiles:tiles.length,plannedTiles:(state.tiles||[]).length,
      rechargeDistribution:normalized,rechargeScore:Number((normalized[0]+normalized[1]).toFixed(1)),
      meanElevationM:elev/totalWeight,meanElevationFt:elev/totalWeight*3.28084,
      runoffCoefficient:runC/totalWeight,precipIn:precip/totalWeight,
      tributaries:tiles.reduce((a,t)=>a+Number(t.tribs||0),0),outGph,
      noBuildPct:noBuild/totalWeight,corridorCount:corridorFeatures.length,corridorLengthM,
      gradeA,gradeB,topOpportunity:ranked[0]||null,runoffInterceptedGph:totGph,
      runoffInterceptPct:Math.min(95,Math.round(totGph/Math.max(1,outGph)*100)),
      countryCode,fieldVerification:"Not verified",
      confidence:{score:Number((confidence/totalWeight).toFixed(1)),version:"Confidence v0",components:confidenceComponents,fieldVerification:"Not verified"}
    };
  }

  }

  function corridorStats(){
    const sw=M.swales||[];let lenFt=0,totGph=0,topGph=0;
    for(const s of sw){
      lenFt+=Number(s.lenM||0)*3.28084;
      const cap=typeof swaleGph==="function"?swaleGph(s):0;
      totGph+=cap;topGph=Math.max(topGph,cap);
    }
    return {lenFt,totGph,topGph};
  }

    async function analyzeTile(tile,parent,index,gen){
    const tileStarted16191=performance.now();
    let lastError=null;
    for(let attempt=1;attempt<=2;attempt++){
      try{
        clearTile(tileSite(tile,parent,index));
        earthlineProgress("dem","tile "+index+" of "+state.tiles.length+" · attempt "+attempt+"…");
        await waitFrame();
        const ok=await rebuildModel(true,gen);
        if(!ok||earthlineIsStale(gen))throw new Error(earthlineIsStale(gen)?"Analysis cancelled":"Terrain or model unavailable");
        if(!(M.vectorNoBuildCoverage&&M.vectorNoBuildCoverage.verified)){
          M.exclusionConfidence="unverified";
          console.warn("[Earthline] "+BUILD+" tile "+index+" has unverified road/structure coverage; terrain-derived output retained and confidence reduced.");
        }else{
          M.exclusionConfidence="verified";
        }
        const cellM=Number(M.cellM||analysisCellM(M.loc));
        // Freeze the exact tile transform. No later global model mutation can move this output.
        M.centerLat=tile.lat;M.centerLng=tile.lng;
        const opportunity=tileOpportunityMetrics15772(tile,cellM,index);
        const snapshot=snapshotTile15778(M.loc,opportunity);
        const priorStat={opportunity,snapshot};
        state.tileStats[index-1]=priorStat;
        const sw=swaleDataForTile(tile,cellM,index),rz=rechargeDataForTile(tile,cellM,index),fl=flowDataForTile(tile,cellM,index);
        const contourFeatures=contourDataForTile15772(tile,cellM,index);
        const cs=corridorStats(),thr=streamThreshold(),trib=censusTributaries(thr);
        appendUnique(state.swales.features,sw.features);appendUnique(state.recharge.features,rz);appendUnique(state.flow.features,fl);
        appendUnique(state.contours.features,contourFeatures);
        state.rawCorridors.push(...sw.raw);
        // Spacing is measured within each independently resolved DEM tile. This avoids
        // unrelated corridors miles apart from distorting the 15–25 ft prescription metric.
        state.spacingSamples.push(...rawSpacingSamples(sw.raw));
        tile.status="complete";
        return {
          status:"complete",tile:index,lat:tile.lat,lng:tile.lng,
          swales:sw.raw.length,lenFt:cs.lenFt,totGph:cs.totGph,topGph:cs.topGph,
          outGph:gph(M.outFlow),tribs:trib.sources,attempts:attempt,
          opportunity,snapshot,
          confidence:snapshot.confidence,rechargeDistribution:snapshot.rechargeDistribution,
          rechargeScore:snapshot.rechargeScore,meanElevationFt:snapshot.meanElevationFt,
          runoffCoefficient:snapshot.runoffCoefficient,exclusions:snapshot.exclusions,
          timings:Object.assign({},M.lastTiming||{},{tileTotalMs:Math.round(performance.now()-tileStarted16191)})
        };
      }catch(err){
        lastError=err;
        if(earthlineIsStale(gen))throw err;
        console.warn("[Earthline] "+BUILD+" tile "+index+" attempt "+attempt+" failed",err);
        if(attempt<2)await waitMs(300);
      }
    }
    tile.status=/exclusion/i.test(String(lastError&&lastError.message))?"withheld":"failed";
    return {status:tile.status,tile:index,error:String(lastError&&lastError.message||"unknown"),timings:{tileTotalMs:Math.round(performance.now()-tileStarted16191)}};
  }

  


  /* BUILD-CHECK-15821 — authoritative property-frame ownership.
     The map camera controls presentation. The selected property identity controls
     the scientific center, boundary, acreage, cell size, and internal DEM zoom. */
  function earthlinePolygonAreaAcres15821(points){
    if(!Array.isArray(points)||points.length<3)return 0;
    const meanLat=points.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+Number(p&&p[1]||0),0)/points.length;
    const mx=111320*Math.max(0.05,Math.cos(meanLat*Math.PI/180));
    const my=111320;
    let area=0;
    for(let i=0,j=points.length-1;i<points.length;j=i++){
      const xi=Number(points[i][0])*mx;
      const yi=Number(points[i][1])*my;
      const xj=Number(points[j][0])*mx;
      const yj=Number(points[j][1])*my;
      area+=(xj*yi)-(xi*yj);
    }
    return Math.abs(area)*0.5/4046.8564224;
  }

  function earthlineBoundarySignature15821(points){
    return (Array.isArray(points)?points:[]).map(p=>[
      Number(Number(p&&p[0]||0).toFixed(8)),
      Number(Number(p&&p[1]||0).toFixed(8))
    ]);
  }

  function earthlinePropertyIdentity15821(parent,anchor){
    const parentLat=Number(parent&&parent.lat);
    const parentLng=Number(parent&&parent.lng);
    const hasParentPoint=Number.isFinite(parentLat)&&Number.isFinite(parentLng);
    const center={
      lat:hasParentPoint?parentLat:Number(anchor&&anchor.lat),
      lng:hasParentPoint?parentLng:Number(anchor&&anchor.lng)
    };
    const placeType=String(parent&&parent.placeType||"").toLowerCase();
    const search=String(M&&M.appliedSearchText||"").trim().toLowerCase();
    const name=String(
      parent&&(parent.fullName||parent.name||parent.sub)||"selected-property"
    ).trim().toLowerCase();
    return{
      key:[
        search||name,
        placeType||"property",
        Number(center.lat).toFixed(6),
        Number(center.lng).toFixed(6)
      ].join("|"),
      center,
      placeType,
      search,
      name
    };
  }


  /* BUILD-CHECK-15827 — one visible, deliberate scientific-frame owner.
     Manual camera movement never changes the scientific frame. A frame changes
     only after a new search, a drawn boundary, or the explicit current-view
     control installed by this build. */
  function earthlineFrameSearchKey15827(frame){
    if(!frame)return "";
    if(frame.searchKey!=null)return String(frame.searchKey);
    const identity=String(frame.identityKey||"");
    return identity.split("|")[0]||"";
  }

  function earthlineCurrentSearchKey15827(){
    return String(M&&M.appliedSearchText||"")
      .trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g," ");
  }

  function earthlineFrameMatchesSearch15827(frame){
    return !!(
      frame&&
      earthlineFrameSearchKey15827(frame)===
        earthlineCurrentSearchKey15827()
    );
  }

  function earthlineRunFrameDirective15827(context){
    if(context&&context.resolvedSearchLoc)return null;
    const searchKey=earthlineCurrentSearchKey15827();
    const pending=state.pendingAnalysisFrame15827||
      M.pendingAnalysisFrame15827||null;

    if(pending&&String(pending.searchKey||"")===searchKey){
      return Object.assign({
        reason:"explicit-current-view-pending"
      },pending);
    }

    const frame=M.authoritativePropertyFrame15821||
      state.authoritativePropertyFrame15821||null;
    if(frame&&earthlineFrameMatchesSearch15827(frame)){
      return{
        reason:"locked-scientific-frame",
        center:{
          lng:Number(frame.center.lng),
          lat:Number(frame.center.lat)
        },
        boundary:(frame.boundary||[]).map(p=>[
          Number(p[0]),Number(p[1])
        ]),
        acres:Number(frame.acres||20),
        internalAnalysisZoom:Number(
          frame.internalAnalysisZoom||18
        ),
        source:String(frame.source||"locked-frame"),
        searchKey
      };
    }
    return null;
  }

  function earthlineResolvePropertyFrame15821(parent,anchor){
    const identity=earthlinePropertyIdentity15821(parent,anchor);
    const searchKey=earthlineCurrentSearchKey15827();
    const pending=state.pendingAnalysisFrame15827||
      M.pendingAnalysisFrame15827||null;
    const existing=M.authoritativePropertyFrame15821||
      state.authoritativePropertyFrame15821||null;

    let center={
      lng:Number(identity.center.lng),
      lat:Number(identity.center.lat)
    };
    let acres=Math.max(
      8,
      Math.min(80,Number(parent&&parent.acres||20))
    );
    let boundary=null;
    let source="fixed-property-analysis-extent";

    if(pending&&String(pending.searchKey||"")===searchKey){
      center={
        lng:Number(pending.center.lng),
        lat:Number(pending.center.lat)
      };
      acres=Number(pending.acres);
      boundary=(pending.boundary||[]).map(p=>[
        Number(p[0]),Number(p[1])
      ]);
      source=String(
        pending.source||"explicit-current-view-analysis-area"
      );
      state.pendingAnalysisFrame15827=null;
      M.pendingAnalysisFrame15827=null;
    }else{
      const drawnBoundary=(
        parent&&
        String(parent.placeType||"").toLowerCase()==="drawn_site"&&
        Array.isArray(parent.analysisBoundaryLngLat)&&
        parent.analysisBoundaryLngLat.length>=3
      )
        ?parent.analysisBoundaryLngLat.map(p=>[
          Number(p[0]),Number(p[1])
        ])
        :null;

      if(drawnBoundary){
        boundary=drawnBoundary;
        const measured=earthlinePolygonAreaAcres15821(boundary);
        if(Number.isFinite(measured)&&measured>=2){
          acres=Math.max(8,Math.min(80,measured));
        }
        source="explicit-drawn-analysis-boundary";
      }else if(existing&&earthlineFrameMatchesSearch15827(existing)){
        return existing;
      }else{
        const explicitBoundary=(
          parent&&parent.userSelectedSite&&
          Array.isArray(parent.analysisBoundaryLngLat)&&
          parent.analysisBoundaryLngLat.length>=3
        )
          ?parent.analysisBoundaryLngLat.map(p=>[
            Number(p[0]),Number(p[1])
          ])
          :null;

        if(explicitBoundary){
          boundary=explicitBoundary;
          const measured=earthlinePolygonAreaAcres15821(boundary);
          if(Number.isFinite(measured)&&measured>=2){
            acres=Math.max(8,Math.min(80,measured));
          }
          source="explicit-selected-analysis-boundary";
        }else{
          boundary=earthlineRectangleAround(
            center.lng,
            center.lat,
            acres
          );
        }
      }
    }

    if(!Array.isArray(boundary)||boundary.length<3){
      boundary=earthlineRectangleAround(
        center.lng,
        center.lat,
        acres
      );
      source="fixed-property-analysis-extent";
    }

    const internalAnalysisZoom=18;
    const frame={
      build:"BUILD-CHECK-15827",
      owner:"earthlineResolvePropertyFrame15821",
      searchKey,
      identityKey:[
        searchKey||identity.name,
        String(parent&&parent.placeType||identity.placeType||"property"),
        Number(center.lat).toFixed(6),
        Number(center.lng).toFixed(6)
      ].join("|"),
      center:{
        lng:Number(center.lng),
        lat:Number(center.lat)
      },
      acres:Number(acres),
      internalAnalysisZoom,
      boundary:earthlineBoundarySignature15821(boundary),
      source,
      viewportIndependent:true,
      changesOnlyByExplicitAction:true,
      resolvedAt:Date.now()
    };

    state.authoritativePropertyFrame15821=frame;
    M.authoritativePropertyFrame15821=frame;

    if(
      source!=="explicit-current-view-analysis-area"&&
      source!=="restored-selected-property-frame"
    ){
      state.selectedPropertyBaseFrame15827=
        JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(frame));
    }

    return frame;
  }

  function degenerateCamera15801(anchor,zoom){
    const lat=Number(anchor&&anchor.lat),lng=Number(anchor&&anchor.lng),z=Number(zoom);
    if(!Number.isFinite(lat)||!Number.isFinite(lng)||!Number.isFinite(z))return true;
    // Exact integer-pair centers are common startup/fallback signatures, not
    // defensible property targets. This is intentionally narrow to avoid
    // rejecting legitimate coordinates merely near a round number.
    const integerPair=
      Math.abs(lat-Math.round(lat))<1e-7&&
      Math.abs(lng-Math.round(lng))<1e-7;
    return integerPair;
  }

  function integrityToleranceM15801(identity,mode){

    if(pt==="poi"||pt==="neighborhood")return 1000;

    return 10000;
  }

/* BUILD-CHECK-15778 — keep the one real Mapbox +/- group beside Run Analysis.
   The buttons and event handlers remain Mapbox-native. */
(function(){
  "use strict";
  function dockNativeZoom15779(){
    try{
      if(typeof earthlineMap==="undefined"||!earthlineMap)return false;
      const dock=document.getElementById("earthlineZoomDock15779");
      if(!dock)return false;

      if(typeof window.earthlineEnsureNativeNavigationControl15784==="function"){
        window.earthlineEnsureNativeNavigationControl15784();
      }
      const zoomIn=document.querySelector(".mapboxgl-ctrl-zoom-in");
      const zoomOut=document.querySelector(".mapboxgl-ctrl-zoom-out");
      const group=zoomIn&&zoomIn.closest(".mapboxgl-ctrl-group");
      if(!group||!zoomOut)return false;

      // One authoritative map dock. Replacing children prevents an old or
      // duplicate control group from surviving a render/style cycle.
      if(group.parentNode!==dock||dock.children.length!==1||dock.firstElementChild!==group){
        dock.replaceChildren(group);
      }

      for(const button of [zoomIn,zoomOut]){
        if(!button||button.dataset.earthlineNavHook15780)continue;
        button.dataset.earthlineNavHook15780="1";
        button.addEventListener("pointerdown",()=>{
          try{
            if(typeof earthlineCancelSearchCameraLock==="function"){
              earthlineCancelSearchCameraLock();
            }
          }catch(e){}
        },{capture:true,passive:true});
      }

      // Remove accidental duplicate zoom groups while preserving the docked native group.
      const groups=[...document.querySelectorAll(".mapboxgl-ctrl-group")]
        .filter(g=>g.querySelector(".mapboxgl-ctrl-zoom-in")&&g.querySelector(".mapboxgl-ctrl-zoom-out"));
      for(const g of groups)if(g!==group)g.remove();
      if(typeof window.earthlineEnforceUniqueUI15784==="function"){
        window.earthlineEnforceUniqueUI15784();
      }
      return !!group;
    }catch(e){
      console.warn("[Earthline] BUILD-CHECK-15773 zoom dock",e);
      return false;
    }
  }

  window.dockNativeZoom15779=dockNativeZoom15779;
  window.earthlineDockNativeZoom15779=dockNativeZoom15779;
  const retry=()=>{if(!dockNativeZoom15779())setTimeout(retry,300);};
  retry();
  try{

    earthlineMap.on("styledata",()=>{}); // 16487 neutralized.
    earthlineMap.on("idle",()=>{}); // 16487 neutralized.
  }catch(e){}
})();

      }
      upstreamSlope=upN?upstreamSlope/upN:localSlope;
      downstreamSlope=downN?downstreamSlope/downN:localSlope;
      const slopeBreak=Math.max(
        0,
        upstreamSlope-downstreamSlope
      );

      const openScore=land.className==="open-or-degraded"
        ?1
        :land.className==="sparse-woodland"
          ?.62
          :land.className==="mature-or-dense-forest"
            ?.15
            :0;
      const exclusionPenalty=excluded?0.08:1;
      const score=(
        Math.log1p(acc)*
        (1+Math.min(2.2,upstreamSlope*6))*
        (1+Math.min(1.5,slopeBreak*10))*
        (.45+.55*openScore)*
        exclusionPenalty
      );

      if(!best||score>best.score){
        best={
          i,x,y,position,
          score,
          accumulation:acc,
          elevationM:Number(M.h[i]),
          localSlopePct:localSlope*100,
          upstreamMeanSlopePct:upstreamSlope*100,
          downstreamMeanSlopePct:downstreamSlope*100,
          slopeBreakPct:slopeBreak*100,
          excluded,
          land
        };
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  function nearestEvidence15825(x,y){
    const coverage=M&&M.coverageDiagnostic15803||null;
    if(!coverage||!coverage.spatial)return null;
    let best=null;

    const inspect=(record,type)=>{
      const dx=Number(record.x)-x;
      const dy=Number(record.y)-y;
      const distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
      if(distance>16)return;
      if(!best||distance<best.distance){
        best={
          type,
          distance,
          record
        };
      }
    };

    for(const record of coverage.spatial.candidates||[]){
      inspect(record,"candidate");
    }
    for(const record of coverage.spatial.seeds||[]){
      inspect(record,"seed");
    }
    return best;
  }

  function reasonForMiss15825(path,opportunity){
    const coverage=M&&M.coverageDiagnostic15803||null;
    const termination=coverage&&coverage.termination||{};
    if(!opportunity){
      return{
        code:"no-safe-contour-crossing",
        confidence:"high",
        evidence:null
      };
    }

    const levelMeta=M&&M.swaleDiagnostics&&
      M.swaleDiagnostics.levelGenerator||{};
    const firstLevel=Number(levelMeta.firstLevel);
    const levelStep=Number(levelMeta.levelStep);
    const processed=Number(
      termination.levelsProcessed||0
    );

    if(
      Number.isFinite(firstLevel)&&
      Number.isFinite(levelStep)&&
      levelStep>0&&processed>0
    ){
      const levelIndex=Math.round(
        (opportunity.elevationM-firstLevel)/levelStep
      );
      if(levelIndex>=processed){
        return{
          code:"level-unprocessed-after-candidate-cap",
          confidence:"high",
          evidence:{
            levelIndex,
            levelsProcessed:processed,
            levelsTotal:Number(
              termination.levelsTotal||0
            )
          }
        };
      }
    }

    const evidence=nearestEvidence15825(
      opportunity.x,
      opportunity.y
    );
    if(evidence&&evidence.type==="candidate"){
      const status=String(
        evidence.record.status||""
      );
      const reason=String(
        evidence.record.reason||""
      );
      if(
        status==="rejected-final-spacing"||
        reason==="minimum-spacing"
      ){
        return{
          code:"spacing-or-deduplication-rejection",
          confidence:"high",
          evidence
        };
      }
      if(
        status==="not-evaluated-final-cap"||
        reason==="final-cap"
      ){
        return{
          code:"not-evaluated-after-final-cap",
          confidence:"high",
          evidence
        };
      }
      if(status==="rejected-overlap"){
        return{
          code:"candidate-overlap-rejection",
          confidence:"high",
          evidence
        };
      }
      if(status==="rejected-short"){
        return{
          code:"minimum-corridor-length-rejection",
          confidence:"high",
          evidence
        };
      }
      if(status==="rejected-conversion"){
        return{
          code:"contour-geometry-conversion-rejection",
          confidence:"high",
          evidence
        };
      }
      if(status==="accepted"){
        return{
          code:"accepted-corridor-nearby-but-no-flow-crossing",
          confidence:"medium",
          evidence
        };
      }
    }

    if(evidence&&evidence.type==="seed"){
      const status=String(
        evidence.record.status||""
      );
      if(status==="not-visited-per-level-cap"){
        return{
          code:"seed-generated-but-not-visited-per-level-cap",
          confidence:"high",
          evidence
        };
      }
      if(status==="traced"){
        return{
          code:"seed-traced-without-accepted-crossing",
          confidence:"medium",
          evidence
        };
      }
      return{
        code:"seed-created-without-accepted-crossing",
        confidence:"medium",
        evidence
      };
    }

    if(opportunity.excluded){
      return{
        code:"safety-or-channel-buffer-exclusion",
        confidence:"medium",
        evidence:{
          noBuild:!!(
            M.noBuildMask&&
            M.noBuildMask[opportunity.i]
          ),
          ponding:!!(
            M.pond&&M.pond[opportunity.i]
          )
        }
      };
    }

    if(
      termination.candidateCapReached||
      termination.finalCapReached
    ){
      return{
        code:"no-nearby-seed-or-candidate-under-truncated-run",
        confidence:"medium",
        evidence:{
          candidateCapReached:
            !!termination.candidateCapReached,
          finalCapReached:
            !!termination.finalCapReached,
          seedsUnprocessedAfterTermination:
            Number(
              termination.seedsUnprocessedAfterTermination||0
            )
        }
      };
    }

    return{
      code:"no-nearby-seed-or-candidate",
      confidence:"medium",
      evidence:null
    };
  }

  function buildPathNetwork15825(){
    const total=GW*GH;
    const streamBase=Math.max(
      2,
      Number(streamThreshold())
    );
    const channelThreshold=Math.max(
      3,
      streamBase*3
    );
    const minorThreshold=Math.max(
      3,
      Math.min(
        channelThreshold*.48,
        streamBase*.72
      )
    );

    const minorMask=new Uint8Array(total);
    for(let i=0;i<total;i++){
      if(M.inP&&!M.inP[i])continue;
      const acc=Number(M.acc[i]||0);
      if(
        acc>=minorThreshold&&
        acc<channelThreshold&&
        Number(M.dir[i])>=0
      ){
        minorMask[i]=1;
      }
    }

    const starts=[];
    for(let i=0;i<total;i++){
      if(!minorMask[i])continue;
      if(incomingMinorCount15825(i,minorMask)===0){
        starts.push(i);
      }
    }
    starts.sort((a,b)=>
      Number(M.acc[b]||0)-Number(M.acc[a]||0)||
      a-b
    );

    const paths=[];
    const seenSignatures=new Set();

    for(const startIndex of starts){
      const cells=[];
      const visited=new Set();
      let i=startIndex;
      let maxAcc=Number(M.acc[i]||0);
      let intercepted=false;
      let firstSwaleIndex=-1;
      let firstCrossingIndex=-1;
      let endedAt="sink-or-exit";

      for(let step=0;step<900;step++){
        if(
          i<0||i>=total||
          visited.has(i)||
          (M.inP&&!M.inP[i])
        ){
          endedAt="parcel-exit-or-loop";
          break;
        }
        visited.add(i);
        cells.push(i);
        maxAcc=Math.max(
          maxAcc,
          Number(M.acc[i]||0)
        );

        if(
          Number(M.acc[i]||0)>=channelThreshold
        ){
          endedAt="channelized";
          break;
        }

        const d=Number(M.dir[i]);
        if(d<0||d>7){
          endedAt="sink";
          break;
        }
        const x=i%GW;
        const y=Math.floor(i/GW);
        const nx=x+D8X[d];
        const ny=y+D8Y[d];
        if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH){
          endedAt="grid-exit";
          break;
        }
        i=idx(nx,ny);
      }

      if(cells.length<3)continue;
      const first=cells[0];
      const last=cells[cells.length-1];
      const signature=[
        first,
        last,
        cells.length
      ].join("|");
      if(seenSignatures.has(signature))continue;
      seenSignatures.add(signature);

      const firstElevation=Number(M.h[first]);
      const lastElevation=Number(M.h[last]);
      let pathLengthM=0;
      let maxSlopePct=0;
      let slopeSum=0;
      let slopeCount=0;
      for(let c=1;c<cells.length;c++){
        const a=cells[c-1];
        const b=cells[c];
        const ax=a%GW;
        const ay=Math.floor(a/GW);
        const bx=b%GW;
        const by=Math.floor(b/GW);
        pathLengthM+=Math.hypot(
          bx-ax,
          by-ay
        )*Math.max(.001,Number(M.cellM||1));
      }
      for(const cell of cells){
        const x=cell%GW;
        const y=Math.floor(cell/GW);
        const slope=Number(slopePct(x,y)||0);
        maxSlopePct=Math.max(maxSlopePct,slope);
        slopeSum+=slope;
        slopeCount++;
      }
      const reliefM=Math.max(
        0,
        firstElevation-lastElevation
      );
      const meanPathGrade=pathLengthM>0
        ?reliefM/pathLengthM
        :0;
      const meanLocalSlopePct=slopeCount
        ?slopeSum/slopeCount
        :0;
      const streamPowerProxy=
        maxAcc*Math.max(.0001,meanPathGrade);

      const crossing=null;
      const opportunity=opportunityAt15825(
        cells,
        channelThreshold
      );

      const path={
        id:"T"+(paths.length+1),
        startIndex,
        cells,
        cellCount:cells.length,
        maxAccumulation:maxAcc,
        intercepted,
        firstSwaleIndex,
        crossing,
        opportunity,
        endedAt,
        pathLengthM,
        reliefM,
        meanPathGradePct:meanPathGrade*100,
        meanLocalSlopePct,
        maxSlopePct,
        streamPowerProxy,
        startLand:landClass15825(
          first%GW,
          Math.floor(first/GW)
        ),
        reason:null
      };

      if(!intercepted){
        path.reason=reasonForMiss15825(
          path,
          opportunity
        );
      }
      paths.push(path);
    }

    return{
      streamBase,
      minorThreshold,
      channelThreshold,
      minorMask,
      paths
    };
  }

  function fixed15838(value,digits=8){
    const n=Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(n)?Number(n.toFixed(digits)):null;
  }

  function stable15838(value){
    if(value===null||typeof value!=="object")return JSON.stringify(value);
    if(Array.isArray(value))return "["+value.map(stable15838).join(",")+"]";
    return "{"+Object.keys(value).sort().map(key=>JSON.stringify(key)+":"+stable15838(value[key])).join(",")+"}";
  }

  function hash15838(value){
    const text=stable15838(value);
    let h1=2166136261,h2=2246822519;
    for(let i=0;i<text.length;i++){
      const c=text.charCodeAt(i);
      h1=Math.imul(h1^c,16777619);
      h2=Math.imul(h2^c,3266489917);
    }
    return (h1>>>0).toString(16).padStart(8,"0")+(h2>>>0).toString(16).padStart(8,"0");
  }

  function geometryFrameDescriptor15838(){
    const frame=M&&M.authoritativePropertyFrame15821||null;
    const center=frame&&frame.center||frame&&frame.modelCenter||null;
    const boundary=frame&&(
      frame.analysisBoundary||frame.boundary||frame.polygon
    )||[];
    const canonicalBoundary=(Array.isArray(boundary)?boundary:[]).map(point=>[
      fixed15838(point&&point[0]),
      fixed15838(point&&point[1])
    ]);
    return{
      boundary:canonicalBoundary,
      grid:{width:Number(GW),height:Number(GH)},
      cellSizeM:fixed15838(M&&M.cellM,6),
      center:{
        lng:fixed15838(center&&center.lng,8),
        lat:fixed15838(center&&center.lat,8)
      },
      resolution:{
        internalAnalysisZoom:fixed15838(frame&&frame.internalAnalysisZoom,4),
        requestedCellM:fixed15838(frame&&frame.requestedCellM,6),
        modelZoom:fixed15838(frame&&frame.modelZoom,4)
      }
    };
  }

  /* BUILD-CHECK-15838 sole attribution writer.
     It runs only after eligible paths are frozen and final accepted/clipped
     corridor geometry has been rasterized. No scorer hit IDs participate. */
  function auditFinalCorridorOwnership15838(paths,swaleRaster){
    const ownerLists=(M.swales||[]).map(()=>[]);
    let hitEvents=0;
    const uniqueHitCells=new Set();

    for(const path of paths){
      let ownerIndex=-1;
      let crossingCell=-1;
      for(const cell of path.cells||[]){
        if(!swaleRaster.mask[cell])continue;
        hitEvents++;
        uniqueHitCells.add(cell);
        if(ownerIndex<0){
          ownerIndex=Number(swaleRaster.idMask[cell]);
          crossingCell=cell;
        }
      }

      path.intercepted=ownerIndex>=0;
      path.firstSwaleIndex=ownerIndex;
      path.crossing=ownerIndex>=0?{
        i:crossingCell,
        x:crossingCell%GW,
        y:Math.floor(crossingCell/GW),
        swaleIndex:ownerIndex,
        swaleId:M.swales[ownerIndex]&&M.swales[ownerIndex].id||null,
        accumulation:Number(M.acc[crossingCell]||0),
        elevationM:Number(M.h[crossingCell]),
        land:landClass15825(crossingCell%GW,Math.floor(crossingCell/GW))
      }:null;
      path.endedAt=path.intercepted?"first-safe-swale-interception":path.endedAt;
      path.opportunity=path.intercepted?path.crossing:opportunityAt15825(path.cells||[],Number(M&&M.canonicalEligiblePaths15838&&M.canonicalEligiblePaths15838.channelThreshold||Infinity));
      path.reason=path.intercepted?null:reasonForMiss15825(path,path.opportunity);
      if(ownerIndex>=0)ownerLists[ownerIndex].push(path.id);
    }

    for(let corridorIndex=0;corridorIndex<(M.swales||[]).length;corridorIndex++){
      const corridor=M.swales[corridorIndex];
      corridor.interceptedPathIds15838=Object.freeze(ownerLists[corridorIndex].slice().sort());
    }

    return Object.freeze({
      writer:"auditFinalCorridorOwnership15838",
      phase:"post-acceptance-post-clipping",
      hitEvents,
      uniqueHitCells:uniqueHitCells.size,
      eligiblePaths:paths.length,
      corridorOwnership:Object.freeze(ownerLists.map((ids,index)=>Object.freeze({
        corridorIndex:index,
        corridorId:M.swales[index]&&M.swales[index].id||null,
        interceptedPathIds:Object.freeze(ids.slice().sort())
      })))
    });
  }

  function uniqueContribution15825(
    swaleRaster,
    thresholds
  ){
    const total=GW*GH;
    let eligibleCells=0;
    let interceptedCells=0;
    let channelizedBeforeInterception=0;
    let sinkOrExitUnserved=0;

    for(let source=0;source<total;source++){
      if(M.inP&&!M.inP[source])continue;

      let i=source;
      let encounteredMinor=false;
      let outcome="not-eligible";
      const visited=new Set();

      for(let step=0;step<1000;step++){
        if(
          i<0||i>=total||
          visited.has(i)||
          (M.inP&&!M.inP[i])
        ){
          if(encounteredMinor){
            outcome="eligible-unserved-exit";
          }
          break;
        }
        visited.add(i);

        const acc=Number(M.acc[i]||0);
        if(
          acc>=thresholds.minorThreshold&&
          acc<thresholds.channelThreshold
        ){
          encounteredMinor=true;
        }

        if(
          encounteredMinor&&
          swaleRaster.mask[i]&&
          acc<thresholds.channelThreshold
        ){
          outcome="intercepted";
          break;
        }

        if(acc>=thresholds.channelThreshold){
          outcome=encounteredMinor
            ?"channelized-before-interception"
            :"not-eligible";
          break;
        }

        const d=Number(M.dir[i]);
        if(d<0||d>7){
          outcome=encounteredMinor
            ?"eligible-unserved-sink"
            :"not-eligible";
          break;
        }
        const x=i%GW;
        const y=Math.floor(i/GW);
        const nx=x+D8X[d];
        const ny=y+D8Y[d];
        if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH){
          outcome=encounteredMinor
            ?"eligible-unserved-exit"
            :"not-eligible";
          break;
        }
        i=idx(nx,ny);
      }

      if(outcome==="not-eligible")continue;
      eligibleCells++;
      if(outcome==="intercepted"){
        interceptedCells++;
      }else if(
        outcome==="channelized-before-interception"
      ){
        channelizedBeforeInterception++;
      }else{
        sinkOrExitUnserved++;
      }
    }

    return{
      method:
        "unique parcel grid cells attributed once to their first safe swale interception before major-channel threshold",
      eligibleContributingCells:eligibleCells,
      interceptedContributingCells:interceptedCells,
      channelizedBeforeInterception,
      sinkOrExitUnserved,
      interceptionPct:percent15825(
        interceptedCells,
        eligibleCells
      ),
      contributingAreaM2:
        eligibleCells*
        Math.pow(Number(M.cellM||1),2),
      interceptedAreaM2:
        interceptedCells*
        Math.pow(Number(M.cellM||1),2)
    };
  }

  function swaleLandCover15825(){
    const result={
      totalLengthM:0,
      openOrDegradedM:0,
      sparseWoodlandM:0,
      matureForestM:0,
      builtOrImperviousM:0
    };

    for(const sw of M.swales||[]){
      const pts=sw&&sw.pts||[];
      for(let p=1;p<pts.length;p++){
        const a=pts[p-1];
        const b=pts[p];
        const mx=(a[0]+b[0])/2;
        const my=(a[1]+b[1])/2;
        const lengthM=Math.hypot(
          b[0]-a[0],
          b[1]-a[1]
        )*Number(M.cellM||1);
        const land=landClass15825(mx,my);
        result.totalLengthM+=lengthM;
        if(land.className==="open-or-degraded"){
          result.openOrDegradedM+=lengthM;
        }else if(land.className==="sparse-woodland"){
          result.sparseWoodlandM+=lengthM;
        }else if(
          land.className==="mature-or-dense-forest"
        ){
          result.matureForestM+=lengthM;
        }else{
          result.builtOrImperviousM+=lengthM;
        }
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  function summarizeReasons15825(paths){
    const counts={};
    for(const path of paths){
      if(path.intercepted)continue;
      const code=path.reason&&path.reason.code||
        "unclassified";
      counts[code]=(counts[code]||0)+1;
    }
    return counts;
  }

  function swaleLandCover15825(){

          b[1]-a[1]

        ){

        }
      }
    }
    return result;

  function svgElement15825(name,attributes){

      SVG_NS,

  function pathData15825(coordinates){
    const points=[];
    for(const coordinate of coordinates||[]){
      try{
        const point=earthlineMap.project(coordinate);
        if(
          point&&Number.isFinite(point.x)&&
          Number.isFinite(point.y)
        ){
          points.push([point.x,point.y]);
        }
      }catch(e){}
    }
    if(points.length<2)return "";
    let d="M"+points[0][0].toFixed(2)+" "+
      points[0][1].toFixed(2);
    for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++){
      d+=" L"+points[i][0].toFixed(2)+" "+
        points[i][1].toFixed(2);
    }
    return d;
  }

  function renderAuditOverlay15825(){
    const svg=ensureOverlay15825();
    if(!svg)return;
    if(!report15825||!Array.isArray(report15825.paths)){
      svg.style.display="none";
      svg.replaceChildren();
      return;
    }

    const container=svg.parentElement;
    const width=Math.max(
      1,
      container&&container.clientWidth||1
    );
    const height=Math.max(
      1,
      container&&container.clientHeight||1
    );
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox","0 0 "+width+" "+height);
    svg.style.display="block";

    const fragment=document.createDocumentFragment();
    for(const path of report15825.paths){
      const d=pathData15825(path.coordinates);
      if(!d)continue;
      const className=path.intercepted
        ?"served-path"
        :path.highValueOpenMiss
          ?"missed-path"
          :"ordinary-missed-path";
      fragment.appendChild(
        svgElement15825("path",{
          d,
          class:className
        })
      );

      const point=path.intercepted
        ?path.crossing
        :path.opportunity;
      if(point){
        const coordinate=earthlineGridToLngLat(
          Number(point.x)+.5,
          Number(point.y)+.5
        );
        try{
          const projected=earthlineMap.project(
            coordinate
          );
          fragment.appendChild(
            svgElement15825("circle",{
              cx:projected.x.toFixed(2),
              cy:projected.y.toFixed(2),
              r:path.intercepted?3.8:5.3,
              class:path.intercepted
                ?"crossing":"opportunity"
            })
          );
        }catch(e){}
      }
    }
    svg.replaceChildren(fragment);
  }

  function traceDiagnosticContour15826(
    sx,sy,level,allowSoftBuffer
  ){
    const cross=(ha,hb)=>{
      const d=hb-ha;
      return Math.abs(d)<1e-9
        ?.5
        :Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(level-ha)/d));
    };

    let start=null;
    for(let radius=0;radius<=9&&!start;radius++){
      for(let oy=-radius;oy<=radius&&!start;oy++){
        for(let ox=-radius;ox<=radius;ox++){
          if(
            Math.max(Math.abs(ox),Math.abs(oy))!==radius
          )continue;
          const x=Math.round(sx)+ox;
          const y=Math.round(sy)+oy;
          if(!diagnosticSafe15826(x,y,allowSoftBuffer))continue;
          const h00=Number(M.h[idx(x,y)]);
          const h10=Number(M.h[idx(x+1,y)]);
          const h01=Number(M.h[idx(x,y+1)]);
          const h11=Number(M.h[idx(x+1,y+1)]);
          if(![h00,h10,h01,h11].every(Number.isFinite))continue;
          const mn=Math.min(h00,h10,h01,h11);
          const mx=Math.max(h00,h10,h01,h11);
          if(level>=mn&&level<=mx&&mx-mn>1e-7){
            start=[x,y];
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if(!start)return [];

    const edgesFor=(cx,cy)=>{
      if(cx<0||cy<0||cx>=GW-1||cy>=GH-1)return [];
      const h00=Number(M.h[idx(cx,cy)]);
      const h10=Number(M.h[idx(cx+1,cy)]);
      const h01=Number(M.h[idx(cx,cy+1)]);
      const h11=Number(M.h[idx(cx+1,cy+1)]);
      const edges=[];
      if((h00<=level)!==(h10<=level)){
        edges.push([0,cx+cross(h00,h10),cy]);
      }
      if((h10<=level)!==(h11<=level)){
        edges.push([1,cx+1,cy+cross(h10,h11)]);
      }
      if((h01<=level)!==(h11<=level)){
        edges.push([2,cx+cross(h01,h11),cy+1]);
      }
      if((h00<=level)!==(h01<=level)){
        edges.push([3,cx,cy+cross(h00,h01)]);
      }
      return edges;
    };

    const walk=firstPick=>{
      const points=[];
      let cx=start[0],cy=start[1],previous=-1;
      const visited=new Set();
      for(let step=0;step<420;step++){
        if(!diagnosticSafe15826(cx,cy,allowSoftBuffer))break;
        const key=cx+"|"+cy+"|"+previous;
        if(visited.has(key))break;
        visited.add(key);

        const edges=edgesFor(cx,cy);
        if(!edges.length)break;
        let choices=previous>=0
          ?edges.filter(edge=>edge[0]!==previous)
          :edges;
        if(!choices.length)choices=edges;
        const pick=step===0
          ?choices[firstPick%choices.length]
          :choices[0];
        points.push([pick[1],pick[2]]);

        if(pick[0]===0){cy-=1;previous=2}
        else if(pick[0]===1){cx+=1;previous=3}
        else if(pick[0]===2){cy+=1;previous=0}
        else{cx-=1;previous=1}
      }
      return points;
    };

    const a=walk(0);
    const b=walk(1);
    const merged=a.slice().reverse().concat(b);
    if(merged.length<5)return [];
    try{return earthlineCleanPath(merged)}catch(e){return merged}
  }

  function corridorLengthM15826(points){
    let length=0;
    for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++){
      length+=Math.hypot(
        points[i][0]-points[i-1][0],
        points[i][1]-points[i-1][1]
      )*Math.max(.001,Number(M.cellM||1));
    }
    return length;
  }

  function nearestSwaleDistanceM15826(points){
    let best=Infinity;
    for(const point of points){
      for(const swale of M.swales||[]){
        const pts=swale&&swale.pts||[];
        for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){
          const ax=pts[i-1][0],ay=pts[i-1][1];
          const bx=pts[i][0],by=pts[i][1];
          const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay;
          const l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
          const t=l2>1e-12
            ?Math.max(
              0,
              Math.min(
                1,
                ((point[0]-ax)*dx+(point[1]-ay)*dy)/l2
              )
            )
            :0;
          best=Math.min(
            best,
            Math.hypot(
              point[0]-(ax+t*dx),
              point[1]-(ay+t*dy)
            )
          );
        }
      }
    }
    return best*Math.max(.001,Number(M.cellM||1));
  }

  function boundsPolygon15827(){
    if(
      !earthlineMap||!earthlineMap.getBounds||
      !earthlineMap.getCenter
    )return null;

    const bounds=earthlineMap.getBounds();
    const center=earthlineMap.getCenter();
    const polygon=[
      [Number(bounds.getWest()),Number(bounds.getSouth())],
      [Number(bounds.getEast()),Number(bounds.getSouth())],
      [Number(bounds.getEast()),Number(bounds.getNorth())],
      [Number(bounds.getWest()),Number(bounds.getNorth())]

      (sum,point)=>sum+Number(point[1]||0),

    )/polygon.length;

      111320*Math.max(
        .05,

    for(let i=0,j=polygon.length-1;i<polygon.length;j=i++){
      const xi=Number(polygon[i][0])*metresPerDegreeX;
      const yi=Number(polygon[i][1])*metresPerDegreeY;
      const xj=Number(polygon[j][0])*metresPerDegreeX;
      const yj=Number(polygon[j][1])*metresPerDegreeY;
      areaM2+=(xj*yi)-(xi*yj);
    }

    const acres=Math.abs(areaM2)*.5/4046.8564224;
    return{
      center:{
        lng:Number(center.lng),
        lat:Number(center.lat)
      },
      boundary:polygon,
      acres:Number(acres),
      zoom:Number(
        earthlineMap.getZoom&&

    };
  }

That is the problem and the full list of what a swale does about it.</p>\n<p><strong>If you have ten</strong>, add §2, §5, and §7 — what the structure is, why this landscape used to do the job itself, and what this report does not claim.</p>\n<p><strong>If you are checking our work</strong>, §6.1 through §6.8 carry the evidence with every figure sourced and marked <strong>(measured)</strong> or <strong>(modeled)</strong>, and §6.7 lists what the evidence does <em>not</em> support. It sheets downhill, gathers into rivulets, then into channels, and leaves the property within hours. Whatever it picks up along the way — soil, fertilizer, road salt, manure — leaves with it.</p>\n<p>That water is not gone from the world. It is gone from <em>here</em>. It arrives in the nearest brook, then the nearest river, then the ocean, having spent almost no time in the ground beneath your feet.</p>\n<p>Two costs follow from this, and they arrive in opposite seasons.</p>\n<p><strong>In spring and after storms, there is too much water at once.</strong> Runoff that moves fast erodes what it crosses. It cuts gullies, undermines banks, and delivers a flood pulse downstream in a few hours instead of a few days.</p>\n<p><strong>In late summer, there is too little.</strong> A stream between rainstorms is not fed by rain. It is fed by groundwater slowly seeping into the channel from the surrounding land — a flow called <em>baseflow</em>. Land that sheds its rain quickly has little stored to give back. The well runs low, the brook runs thin, and the pasture browns first.</p>\n<p>Both problems have the same cause: the water moved too fast to be kept.</p>\n<p><strong>These are not two problems. They are one problem, arriving in two seasons.</strong></p>\n<p>Vermont saw both inside two years. July 2023 was the wettest summer on record, with catastrophic flooding. August 2025 was the driest August since 1895 — record-low streamflow and groundwater, more than four hundred families reporting dry wells in a single season, four times what the state had recorded in the previous nine years combined. Well drillers stopped taking new customers until spring.</p>\n<p>Two summers apart, in the same hills.</p>\n<hr />\n","<h2>§2 · What a bioswale is</h2>\n<p>A bioswale is a shallow, planted trench dug <em>along the contour</em> of a slope — level from end to end, so water cannot run along it. Soil excavated from the trench is mounded on the downhill side to form a low berm.</p>\n<p>That is the whole structure. No concrete, no pipe, no pump, no moving parts.</p>\n<p>Water running downhill meets the trench and stops. Held there, it does the one thing runoff never does: it waits. And while it waits, it soaks downward through the soil.</p>\n<p>The three words on this report describe the sequence:</p>\n<p><strong>Slow it.</strong> The trench interrupts downhill flow and drops the water's speed to zero. Speed is what causes erosion; removing it removes the damage.</p>\n<p><strong>Sink it.</strong> Standing water infiltrates. It passes down through soil and rock and joins the groundwater below — the saturated zone that feeds wells and springs.</p>\n<p><strong>Spread it.</strong> Because the trench is level, water spreads sideways along its full length instead of concentrating at one point. A hundred feet of swale infiltrates across a hundred feet of ground.</p>\n<p>This is old technology. Contour water-harvesting earthworks appear independently in Andean, South Asian, North African, and Southwestern Indigenous agriculture, in some cases for thousands of years.   function openInstitutionalReportTab16164(data,html){

function buildRegionalTerrain(){
  // Fast state/region view: do not download hundreds of high-res parcel tiles.
  // Build a smooth planning-grade terrain canvas sized to the searched bbox plus context.
  const L=M.loc, bb=L&&L.bbox;
  if(!bb){buildTerrainProceduralWrap();return;}
  const latC=(bb[1]+bb[3])/2, lngC=(bb[0]+bb[2])/2;
  M.centerLat=latC; M.centerLng=lngC;
  const wM=Math.abs(bb[2]-bb[0])*111320*Math.cos(latC*Math.PI/180);
  const hM=Math.abs(bb[3]-bb[1])*111320;
  M.cellM=Math.max(wM/GW,hM/GH)*1.55; // whole state + visible surrounding-state edges
  const seed=M.seed%100000;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    const nx=x/GW, ny=y/GH;
    // Colorado-like regional relief: west highlands, plains east, broad basins.
    const west=Math.max(0,1-nx);
    const ridge=Math.exp(-Math.pow((nx-0.23)/0.12,2))*(0.75+0.25*Math.sin(ny*18));
    const basin=Math.exp(-Math.pow((ny-0.62)/0.10,2))*0.25;
    const broad=fbm(nx*3.0,ny*3.0,seed+30,4)*0.28;
    const fine=fbm(nx*10.0,ny*10.0,seed+77,3)*0.08;
    M.h[idx(x,y)]=(west*0.65+ridge*0.75-basin+broad+fine)*900;
  }
  M.satCanvas=null;
}

/* ---------------- priority-flood pit fill ---------------- */
async function pitFill(myGen=M.searchGen){
  M.fill.set(M.h);
  const heapE=new Float64Array(N+1),heapI=new Int32Array(N+1);
  let hn=0,ops=0;
  function push(e,i){
    hn++;let c=hn;heapE[c]=e;heapI[c]=i;

      const te=heapE[p];heapE[p]=heapE[c];heapE[c]=te;
      const ti=heapI[p];heapI[p]=heapI[c];heapI[c]=ti;c=p;}
  }
  function pop(){

      let l=c*2,r=l+1,m=c;
      if(l<=hn&&heapE[l]<heapE[m])m=l;
      if(r<=hn&&heapE[r]<heapE[m])m=r;
      if(m===c)break;
      const te=heapE[m];heapE[m]=heapE[c];heapE[c]=te;
      const ti=heapI[m];heapI[m]=heapI[c];heapI[c]=ti;c=m;
    }
    return ri;

  const EPS=0.0008;
  while(hn>0){
    const c=pop();
    const cx=c%GW,cy=(c/GW)|0,ce=M.fill[c];
    for(let d=0;d<8;d++){
      const nx=cx+D8X[d],ny=cy+D8Y[d];
      if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)continue;
      const ni=idx(nx,ny);if(seen[ni])continue;
      seen[ni]=1;if(M.fill[ni]<ce+EPS)M.fill[ni]=ce+EPS;push(M.fill[ni],ni);
    }
    if((++ops&2047)===0){earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");}
  }
  let pondCount=0;
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    M.pond[i]=(M.fill[i]-M.h[i]>0.06)?1:0;
    if(M.pond[i]&&M.inP[i])pondCount++;

  }
  M.pondCells=pondCount;
}

/* ---------------- D8 direction + accumulation ---------------- */
async function flowRoute(myGen=M.searchGen){
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++){
    for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
      const i=idx(x,y),e=M.fill[i];

        if(s>bestS){bestS=s;best=d;}
      }
      M.dir[i]=best;
    }
    if((y&7)===7){earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");}
  }

  earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");
  Array.prototype.sort.call(order,(a,b)=>f[b]-f[a]);
  earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");
  M.acc.fill(1);
  let maxAcc=1,outFlow=0;
  for(let k=0;k<N;k++){
    const i=order[k],d=M.dir[i];
    if(d<0){if(M.inP[i])outFlow+=M.acc[i];continue;}
    const x=i%GW,y=(i/GW)|0;
    const ni=idx(x+D8X[d],y+D8Y[d]);

    if(M.inP[i]&&!M.inP[ni])outFlow+=M.acc[i];

  }
  M.maxAcc=maxAcc;M.outFlow=outFlow;
}

/* ---------------- thresholds, census, helpers ---------------- */
function streamThreshold(){
  const rainF=1-(M.rain-5)/95*0.85;          // heavier rain reveals more rills
  let base=Math.max(2,M.maxAcc*0.005*rainF);
  // At regional scale the coarse DEM makes D8 produce straight grid-locked tributary
  // artifacts on near-flat ground. Raise the threshold sharply so only MAJOR rivers
  // (high real accumulation) render — these are genuine and not grid artifacts.
  if(!swaleDetailScale()){                    // zoomed out to watershed/regional
    base=Math.max(base,M.maxAcc*0.06);        // only the strongest channels
  }
  return base;
}
function censusTributaries(thr){
  let sources=0,lenCells=0;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    const i=idx(x,y);
    if(M.acc[i]<thr||!M.inP[i])continue;
    lenCells++;
    let hasUp=false;
    for(let d=0;d<8;d++){
      const nx=x+D8X[d],ny=y+D8Y[d];
      if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)continue;
      const ni=idx(nx,ny);
      if(M.acc[ni]>=thr&&M.dir[ni]>=0){
        const dx=nx+D8X[M.dir[ni]],dy=ny+D8Y[M.dir[ni]];
        if(dx===x&&dy===y){hasUp=true;break;}
      }
    }
    if(!hasUp)sources++;
  }
  return {sources,lenCells};
}

// BUILD-CHECK-15672: natural-looking map geometry without inventing decorative paths.
// Raw contour points come from the DEM grid. For display we soften raster corners, then
// project each interpolated point back toward the source contour elevation. This keeps the
// visible line faithful to the terrain while removing the straight, segmented appearance.
function earthlineMedian(values){
  if(!values||!values.length)return 0;
  const a=values.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y),m=(a.length-1)/2;
  return (a[Math.floor(m)]+a[Math.ceil(m)])/2;
}
function earthlineProjectToContourPoint(p,targetH){
  let x=clamp(p[0],0,GW-1),y=clamp(p[1],0,GH-1);
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
    const err=hAt(x,y)-targetH;
    const g=gradCell(x,y),g2=g[0]*g[0]+g[1]*g[1];
    if(g2<1e-8||Math.abs(err)<0.012)break;
    const step=clamp(err/g2,-0.32,0.32);
    x=clamp(x-g[0]*step,0,GW-1);
    y=clamp(y-g[1]*step,0,GH-1);
  }
  return [x,y];
}
function earthlineNaturalContourDisplay(pts){
  if(!pts||pts.length<4)return pts||[];
  const targetH=earthlineMedian(pts.map(p=>hAt(p[0],p[1])));
  let current=pts.map(p=>[p[0],p[1]]);
  const passes=current.length>18?2:1;
  for(let pass=0;pass<passes;pass++){
    const next=[current[0]];
    for(let i=0;i<current.length-1;i++){
      const a=current[i],b=current[i+1];
      next.push([a[0]*0.72+b[0]*0.28,a[1]*0.72+b[1]*0.28]);
      next.push([a[0]*0.28+b[0]*0.72,a[1]*0.28+b[1]*0.72]);
    }
    next.push(current[current.length-1]);
    current=next;
  }
  const corrected=current.map((p,i)=>{
    if(i===0||i===current.length-1)return p;
    const q=earthlineProjectToContourPoint(p,targetH);
    const gx=Math.round(q[0]),gy=Math.round(q[1]);
    // Never smooth a displayed line through a road, structure, stream, or steep/no-build cell.
    return earthlinePathPointUsable(gx,gy,33)?q:p;
  });
  return earthlineCleanPath(corrected);
}
function earthlineFinalSafeSegments15771(pts,maxS=33){
  const out=[];let cur=[];let prev=null;
  const flush=()=>{
    if(cur.length>=2&&earthlinePathLengthM(cur)>=10)out.push(earthlineCleanPath(cur));
    cur=[];
  };
  for(const p of (pts||[])){
    let ok=earthlinePathPointUsable(p[0],p[1],maxS);
    if(ok&&prev){
      const steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(p[0]-prev[0],p[1]-prev[1])*2));
      for(let k=1;k<steps;k++){
        const t=k/steps;
        if(!earthlinePathPointUsable(
          prev[0]+(p[0]-prev[0])*t,
          prev[1]+(p[1]-prev[1])*t,
          maxS
        )){ok=false;break;}
      }
    }
    if(ok)cur.push(p);else flush();
    prev=p;
  }
  flush();
  return out;
}
function earthlinePathLengthM(pts){
  if(!pts||pts.length<2)return 0;
  let d=0;for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++)d+=Math.hypot(pts[i][0]-pts[i-1][0],pts[i][1]-pts[i-1][1]);
  return d*M.cellM;
}

function earthlineSwaleGeoJSON(){
  const features=[];
  const hasManual=Array.isArray(M.manualNoBuild)&&M.manualNoBuild.length>0;
  const targetM=(M.swaleMeta&&M.swaleMeta.targetSpacingM)||30;
  const minVisibleM=Math.max(20,targetM*0.82);
  for(const s of (M.swales||[])){
    let segs=(typeof earthlineSplitUsableSegments==="function")?earthlineSplitUsableSegments(s.pts,33):[s.pts];
    // BUILD-CHECK-15768: if exclusion clipping removes the corridor, withhold it.
    // Never restore the original unclipped path across a road, structure, or waterway.
    if(!segs||!segs.length)continue;
    for(const seg of (segs||[])){
      if(!seg||seg.length<2)continue;
      const rawLen=earthlinePathLengthM(seg);
      // Suppress isolated raster fragments. The underlying candidate remains in the report,
      // but the map shows only field-legible corridors unless it is the central site candidate.
      if(rawLen<minVisibleM&&!s.isSite)continue;
      const displaySeg=earthlineNaturalContourDisplay(seg);
      for(const safeDisplay of earthlineFinalSafeSegments15771(displaySeg,33)){
        if(!safeDisplay||safeDisplay.length<2)continue;
        features.push({type:"Feature",properties:{id:s.id||"",score:Number(s.score||0),scale:"property"},
          geometry:{type:"LineString",coordinates:safeDisplay.map(p=>earthlineGridToLngLat(p[0],p[1]))}});
      }
    }
  }
  return {type:"FeatureCollection",features};
}

function earthlineSyncSwaleLayer(){
  if(!earthlineMapActive())return false;
  if(!earthlineEnsureSwaleLayers())return false;
  const data=earthlineSwaleGeoJSON();
  const src=earthlineMap.getSource(EARTHLINE_SWALE_SOURCE);
  if(src&&src.setData)src.setData(data);
  const show=!!(M.layers&&M.layers.swales&&M.layers.swales.on&&data.features.length);
  for(const id of [EARTHLINE_SWALE_CASING,EARTHLINE_SWALE_LAYER]){
    if(earthlineMap.getLayer(id))earthlineMap.setLayoutProperty(id,"visibility",show?"visible":"none");
  }
  return show;
}

function hashStr(s){let h=2166136261;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){h^=s.charCodeAt(i);h=Math.imul(h,16777619);}return h>>>0;}
function mulberry32(a){return function(){a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;};}
function latHash(ix,iy,seed){let n=ix*374761393+iy*668265263+seed*1442695041;n=(n^(n>>13))*1274126177;n=n^(n>>16);return(n>>>0)/4294967296;}
function smoothT(t){return t*t*(3-2*t);}
function vnoise(x,y,seed){
  const ix=Math.floor(x),iy=Math.floor(y),fx=x-ix,fy=y-iy;
  const a=latHash(ix,iy,seed),b=latHash(ix+1,iy,seed),c=latHash(ix,iy+1,seed),d=latHash(ix+1,iy+1,seed);
  const u=smoothT(fx),v=smoothT(fy);
  return a*(1-u)*(1-v)+b*u*(1-v)+c*(1-u)*v+d*u*v;
}

function hashStr(s){let h=2166136261;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){h^=s.charCodeAt(i);h=Math.imul(h,16777619);}return h>>>0;}
function mulberry32(a){return function(){a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;};}

function smoothT(t){return t*t*(3-2*t);}
function vnoise(x,y,seed){
  const ix=Math.floor(x),iy=Math.floor(y),fx=x-ix,fy=y-iy;
  const a=latHash(ix,iy,seed),b=latHash(ix+1,iy,seed),c=latHash(ix,iy+1,seed),d=latHash(ix+1,iy+1,seed);
  const u=smoothT(fx),v=smoothT(fy);
  return a*(1-u)*(1-v)+b*u*(1-v)+c*(1-u)*v+d*u*v;
}

/* ---------------- terrain ---------------- */
function pointInPoly(px,py,poly){
  let inside=false;
  for(let i=0,j=poly.length-1;i<poly.length;j=i++){
    const xi=poly[i][0],yi=poly[i][1],xj=poly[j][0],yj=poly[j][1];
    if(((yi>py)!==(yj>py))&&(px<(xj-xi)*(py-yi)/(yj-yi)+xi))inside=!inside;
  }
  return inside;
}

  const L=M.loc, bb=L&&L.bbox;
  if(!bb){buildTerrainProceduralWrap();return;}
  const latC=(bb[1]+bb[3])/2, lngC=(bb[0]+bb[2])/2;
  M.centerLat=latC; M.centerLng=lngC;
  const wM=Math.abs(bb[2]-bb[0])*111320*Math.cos(latC*Math.PI/180);
  const hM=Math.abs(bb[3]-bb[1])*111320;
  M.cellM=Math.max(wM/GW,hM/GH)*1.55; // whole state + visible surrounding-state edges
  const seed=M.seed%100000;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    const nx=x/GW, ny=y/GH;
    // Colorado-like regional relief: west highlands, plains east, broad basins.
    const west=Math.max(0,1-nx);
    const ridge=Math.exp(-Math.pow((nx-0.23)/0.12,2))*(0.75+0.25*Math.sin(ny*18));
    const basin=Math.exp(-Math.pow((ny-0.62)/0.10,2))*0.25;
    const broad=fbm(nx*3.0,ny*3.0,seed+30,4)*0.28;
    const fine=fbm(nx*10.0,ny*10.0,seed+77,3)*0.08;
    M.h[idx(x,y)]=(west*0.65+ridge*0.75-basin+broad+fine)*900;
  }
  M.satCanvas=null;
}

// BUILD-CHECK-15672: regional mode uses one lightweight 3x3 satellite mosaic only.
// It does not download Terrain-RGB, decode a statewide DEM, or run parcel hydrology.
async function fetchRegionalSatellite(myGen=M.searchGen){
  buildRegionalTerrain();
  if(!MB_ON()||!M.loc||!M.loc.bbox)return true;
  const z=Math.round(clamp(M.viewZoom||5,3,8));
  const lat=M.centerLat,lng=M.centerLng;
  const tf=lonLatToTile(lng,lat,z);
  const cx=Math.floor(tf[0]),cy=Math.floor(tf[1]);
  const nMax=Math.pow(2,z)-1,rad=1,span=3;
  const tmpl="https://api.mapbox.com/v4/mapbox.satellite/{z}/{x}/{y}@2x.jpg90?access_token="+MAPBOX_TOKEN;
  const jobs=[];
  for(let dy=-rad;dy<=rad;dy++)for(let dx=-rad;dx<=rad;dx++){
    const tx=clamp(cx+dx,0,nMax),ty=clamp(cy+dy,0,nMax);
    const url=tmpl.replace("{z}",z).replace("{x}",tx).replace("{y}",ty);
    jobs.push(loadImg(url).catch(()=>null));
  }
  const imgs=await Promise.all(jobs);
  if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
  if(imgs.every(im=>!im))return true; // procedural regional fallback remains usable
  const mosaic=document.createElement("canvas");mosaic.width=512*span;mosaic.height=512*span;
  const mg=mosaic.getContext("2d");let k=0;
  for(let row=0;row<span;row++)for(let col=0;col<span;col++){
    const im=imgs[k++];if(im)mg.drawImage(im,col*512,row*512);
  }
  const px0=(tf[0]-(cx-rad))*512,py0=(tf[1]-(cy-rad))*512;
  const mpp=mppAt(z,lat);
  const wPx=GW*M.cellM/mpp,hPx=GH*M.cellM/mpp;
  const satOut=document.createElement("canvas");satOut.width=840;satOut.height=584;
  satOut.getContext("2d").drawImage(mosaic,px0-wPx/2,py0-hPx/2,wPx,hPx,0,0,840,584);
  M.satCanvas=satOut;
  return true;
}
