/* ---------------- priority-flood pit fill ---------------- */
async function pitFill(myGen=M.searchGen){
  M.fill.set(M.h);
  const heapE=new Float64Array(N+1),heapI=new Int32Array(N+1);
  let hn=0,ops=0;
  function push(e,i){
    hn++;let c=hn;heapE[c]=e;heapI[c]=i;
    while(c>1){const p=c>>1;if(heapE[p]<=heapE[c])break;
      const te=heapE[p];heapE[p]=heapE[c];heapE[c]=te;
      const ti=heapI[p];heapI[p]=heapI[c];heapI[c]=ti;c=p;}
  }
  function pop(){
    const ri=heapI[1];heapE[1]=heapE[hn];heapI[1]=heapI[hn];hn--;
    let c=1;
    while(true){
      let l=c*2,r=l+1,m=c;
      if(l<=hn&&heapE[l]<heapE[m])m=l;
      if(r<=hn&&heapE[r]<heapE[m])m=r;
      if(m===c)break;
      const te=heapE[m];heapE[m]=heapE[c];heapE[c]=te;
      const ti=heapI[m];heapI[m]=heapI[c];heapI[c]=ti;c=m;
    }
    return ri;
  }
  const seen=new Uint8Array(N);
  for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){push(M.fill[idx(x,0)],idx(x,0));seen[idx(x,0)]=1;push(M.fill[idx(x,GH-1)],idx(x,GH-1));seen[idx(x,GH-1)]=1;}
  for(let y=1;y<GH-1;y++){push(M.fill[idx(0,y)],idx(0,y));seen[idx(0,y)]=1;push(M.fill[idx(GW-1,y)],idx(GW-1,y));seen[idx(GW-1,y)]=1;}
  const EPS=0.0008;
  while(hn>0){
    const c=pop();
    const cx=c%GW,cy=(c/GW)|0,ce=M.fill[c];
    for(let d=0;d<8;d++){
      const nx=cx+D8X[d],ny=cy+D8Y[d];
      if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)continue;
      const ni=idx(nx,ny);if(seen[ni])continue;
      seen[ni]=1;if(M.fill[ni]<ce+EPS)M.fill[ni]=ce+EPS;push(M.fill[ni],ni);
    }
    if((++ops&2047)===0){earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");}
  }
  let pondCount=0;
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    M.pond[i]=(M.fill[i]-M.h[i]>0.06)?1:0;
    if(M.pond[i]&&M.inP[i])pondCount++;
    if((i&8191)===8191){earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");}
  }
  M.pondCells=pondCount;
}

/* ---------------- D8 direction + accumulation ---------------- */
async function flowRoute(myGen=M.searchGen){
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++){
    for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
      const i=idx(x,y),e=M.fill[i];
      let best=-1,bestS=0;
      for(let d=0;d<8;d++){
        const nx=x+D8X[d],ny=y+D8Y[d];
        if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)continue;
        const s=(e-M.fill[idx(nx,ny)])/D8D[d];
        if(s>bestS){bestS=s;best=d;}
      }
      M.dir[i]=best;
    }
    if((y&7)===7){earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");}
  }
  const order=new Int32Array(N);
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++)order[i]=i;
  const f=M.fill;
  // Sorting 30k cells is acceptable, but yield before and after so the UI can repaint.
  earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");
  Array.prototype.sort.call(order,(a,b)=>f[b]-f[a]);
  earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");
  M.acc.fill(1);
  let maxAcc=1,outFlow=0;
  for(let k=0;k<N;k++){
    const i=order[k],d=M.dir[i];
    if(d<0){if(M.inP[i])outFlow+=M.acc[i];continue;}
    const x=i%GW,y=(i/GW)|0;
    const ni=idx(x+D8X[d],y+D8Y[d]);
    M.acc[ni]+=M.acc[i];
    if(M.inP[i]&&!M.inP[ni])outFlow+=M.acc[i];
    if(M.acc[ni]>maxAcc)maxAcc=M.acc[ni];
    if((k&2047)===2047){earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");}
  }
  M.maxAcc=maxAcc;M.outFlow=outFlow;
}

/* ---------------- thresholds, census, helpers ---------------- */
function streamThreshold(){
  const rainF=1-(M.rain-5)/95*0.85;          // heavier rain reveals more rills
  let base=Math.max(2,M.maxAcc*0.005*rainF);
  // At regional scale the coarse DEM makes D8 produce straight grid-locked tributary
  // artifacts on near-flat ground. Raise the threshold sharply so only MAJOR rivers
  // (high real accumulation) render — these are genuine and not grid artifacts.
  if(!swaleDetailScale()){                    // zoomed out to watershed/regional
    base=Math.max(base,M.maxAcc*0.06);        // only the strongest channels
  }
  return base;
}
function censusTributaries(thr){
  let sources=0,lenCells=0;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    const i=idx(x,y);
    if(M.acc[i]<thr||!M.inP[i])continue;
    lenCells++;
    let hasUp=false;
    for(let d=0;d<8;d++){
      const nx=x+D8X[d],ny=y+D8Y[d];
      if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)continue;
      const ni=idx(nx,ny);
      if(M.acc[ni]>=thr&&M.dir[ni]>=0){
        const dx=nx+D8X[M.dir[ni]],dy=ny+D8Y[M.dir[ni]];
        if(dx===x&&dy===y){hasUp=true;break;}
      }
    }
    if(!hasUp)sources++;
  }
  return {sources,lenCells};
}

/* ---------------- priority-flood pit fill ---------------- */
async function pitFill(myGen=M.searchGen){
  M.fill.set(M.h);
  const heapE=new Float64Array(N+1),heapI=new Int32Array(N+1);
  let hn=0,ops=0;
  function push(e,i){
    hn++;let c=hn;heapE[c]=e;heapI[c]=i;
    while(c>1){const p=c>>1;if(heapE[p]<=heapE[c])break;
      const te=heapE[p];heapE[p]=heapE[c];heapE[c]=te;
      const ti=heapI[p];heapI[p]=heapI[c];heapI[c]=ti;c=p;}
  }
  function pop(){
    const ri=heapI[1];heapE[1]=heapE[hn];heapI[1]=heapI[hn];hn--;
    let c=1;
    while(true){
      let l=c*2,r=l+1,m=c;
      if(l<=hn&&heapE[l]<heapE[m])m=l;
      if(r<=hn&&heapE[r]<heapE[m])m=r;
      if(m===c)break;
      const te=heapE[m];heapE[m]=heapE[c];heapE[c]=te;
      const ti=heapI[m];heapI[m]=heapI[c];heapI[c]=ti;c=m;
    }
    return ri;
  }
  const seen=new Uint8Array(N);
  for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){push(M.fill[idx(x,0)],idx(x,0));seen[idx(x,0)]=1;push(M.fill[idx(x,GH-1)],idx(x,GH-1));seen[idx(x,GH-1)]=1;}
  for(let y=1;y<GH-1;y++){push(M.fill[idx(0,y)],idx(0,y));seen[idx(0,y)]=1;push(M.fill[idx(GW-1,y)],idx(GW-1,y));seen[idx(GW-1,y)]=1;}
  const EPS=0.0008;
  while(hn>0){
    const c=pop();
    const cx=c%GW,cy=(c/GW)|0,ce=M.fill[c];
    for(let d=0;d<8;d++){
      const nx=cx+D8X[d],ny=cy+D8Y[d];
      if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)continue;
      const ni=idx(nx,ny);if(seen[ni])continue;
      seen[ni]=1;if(M.fill[ni]<ce+EPS)M.fill[ni]=ce+EPS;push(M.fill[ni],ni);
    }
    if((++ops&2047)===0){earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");}
  }
  let pondCount=0;
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    M.pond[i]=(M.fill[i]-M.h[i]>0.06)?1:0;
    if(M.pond[i]&&M.inP[i])pondCount++;

  }

}

/* ---------------- D8 direction + accumulation ---------------- */
async function flowRoute(myGen=M.searchGen){
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++){
    for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
      const i=idx(x,y),e=M.fill[i];
      let best=-1,bestS=0;
      for(let d=0;d<8;d++){
        const nx=x+D8X[d],ny=y+D8Y[d];
        if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)continue;
        const s=(e-M.fill[idx(nx,ny)])/D8D[d];
        if(s>bestS){bestS=s;best=d;}
      }
      M.dir[i]=best;
    }
    if((y&7)===7){earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");}
  }
  const order=new Int32Array(N);
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++)order[i]=i;
  const f=M.fill;
  // Sorting 30k cells is acceptable, but yield before and after so the UI can repaint.
  earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");
  Array.prototype.sort.call(order,(a,b)=>f[b]-f[a]);
  earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");
  M.acc.fill(1);
  let maxAcc=1,outFlow=0;
  for(let k=0;k<N;k++){
    const i=order[k],d=M.dir[i];
    if(d<0){if(M.inP[i])outFlow+=M.acc[i];continue;}
    const x=i%GW,y=(i/GW)|0;
    const ni=idx(x+D8X[d],y+D8Y[d]);
    M.acc[ni]+=M.acc[i];
    if(M.inP[i]&&!M.inP[ni])outFlow+=M.acc[i];
    if(M.acc[ni]>maxAcc)maxAcc=M.acc[ni];
    if((k&2047)===2047){earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"hydrology");}
  }
  M.maxAcc=maxAcc;M.outFlow=outFlow;
}

/* ---------------- thresholds, census, helpers ---------------- */
function streamThreshold(){
  const rainF=1-(M.rain-5)/95*0.85;          // heavier rain reveals more rills
  let base=Math.max(2,M.maxAcc*0.005*rainF);
  // At regional scale the coarse DEM makes D8 produce straight grid-locked tributary
  // artifacts on near-flat ground. Raise the threshold sharply so only MAJOR rivers
  // (high real accumulation) render — these are genuine and not grid artifacts.
  if(!swaleDetailScale()){                    // zoomed out to watershed/regional
    base=Math.max(base,M.maxAcc*0.06);        // only the strongest channels
  }
  return base;
}
function censusTributaries(thr){
  let sources=0,lenCells=0;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    const i=idx(x,y);
    if(M.acc[i]<thr||!M.inP[i])continue;
    lenCells++;
    let hasUp=false;
    for(let d=0;d<8;d++){
      const nx=x+D8X[d],ny=y+D8Y[d];
      if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)continue;
      const ni=idx(nx,ny);
      if(M.acc[ni]>=thr&&M.dir[ni]>=0){
        const dx=nx+D8X[M.dir[ni]],dy=ny+D8Y[M.dir[ni]];
        if(dx===x&&dy===y){hasUp=true;break;}
      }
    }
    if(!hasUp)sources++;
  }
  return {sources,lenCells};
}
function gradAt(x,y){
  const x0=clamp(x-1,0,GW-1),x1=clamp(x+1,0,GW-1);
  const y0=clamp(y-1,0,GH-1),y1=clamp(y+1,0,GH-1);
  const gx=(M.h[idx(x1,y)]-M.h[idx(x0,y)])/((x1-x0)*M.cellM);
  const gy=(M.h[idx(x,y1)]-M.h[idx(x,y0)])/((y1-y0)*M.cellM);
  return [gx,gy];
}
// bilinear elevation at fractional cell (x,y), in the same units as M.h (meters)
function hAt(x,y){
  const x0=clamp(Math.floor(x),0,GW-1),y0=clamp(Math.floor(y),0,GH-1);
  const x1=clamp(x0+1,0,GW-1),y1=clamp(y0+1,0,GH-1);
  const fx=x-x0,fy=y-y0;
  const h00=M.h[idx(x0,y0)],h10=M.h[idx(x1,y0)],h01=M.h[idx(x0,y1)],h11=M.h[idx(x1,y1)];
  return h00*(1-fx)*(1-fy)+h10*fx*(1-fy)+h01*(1-fx)*fy+h11*fx*fy;
}
// gradient in elevation-per-CELL (not per-meter), for the contour corrector working in cell space
function gradCell(x,y){
  const x0=clamp(Math.round(x)-1,0,GW-1),x1=clamp(Math.round(x)+1,0,GW-1);
  const y0=clamp(Math.round(y)-1,0,GH-1),y1=clamp(Math.round(y)+1,0,GH-1);
  const gx=(M.h[idx(x1,Math.round(y))]-M.h[idx(x0,Math.round(y))])/(x1-x0||1);
  const gy=(M.h[idx(Math.round(x),y1)]-M.h[idx(Math.round(x),y0)])/(y1-y0||1);
  return [gx,gy];
}

function gph(accCells){

/* ---------------- recharge zones + donut (model-derived) ---------------- */
// Aquifer permeability at a grid cell: if the cell falls inside a fetched USGS aquifer
// polygon, use that aquifer's rock-type permeability; otherwise a low baseline (recharge
// is still possible but less certain without a mapped principal aquifer).
function aquiferPermAt(x,y){
  if(!M.usgsAquifers||!M.usgsAquifers.length)return 0.45;
  for(const poly of M.usgsAquifers){
    const pts=poly.pts;let inside=false;
    for(let a=0,b=pts.length-1;a<pts.length;b=a++){
      const xi=pts[a][0],yi=pts[a][1],xj=pts[b][0],yj=pts[b][1];
      if(((yi>y)!==(yj>y))&&(x<(xj-xi)*(y-yi)/((yj-yi)||1e-9)+xi))inside=!inside;
    }
    if(inside)return poly.perm||0.7;
  }
  return 0.45;
}
// Recharge suitability per cell, grounded in the GIS-MCDA managed-aquifer-recharge
// literature. Criteria, weighted by their established importance:
//   aquifer permeability (top criterion) · soil infiltration · slope (flatter better) ·
//   runoff/flow accumulation (water source) · aridity-as-NEED (drier = more valuable).
// The aridity term is why a drought region should NOT read as low: the need is high.
function rechSuit(i){
  const x=i%GW,y=(i/GW)|0;
  const aqf=aquiferPermAt(x,y);                                  // 0..1 aquifer permeability
  const soilV=(typeof soilPercAt==="function")?soilPercAt(x,y):-1;
  const soil=soilV>=0?soilV:0.55;                                // 0..1 soil infiltration
  const fa=Math.log(M.acc[i]+1)/Math.log(M.maxAcc+1);           // 0..1 runoff source
  const sl=clamp(1-slopePct(x,y)/12,0,1);                        // flatter = better
  const precip=(M.loc&&M.loc.precipIn)||30;
  const need=clamp((45-precip)/40,0,1);                          // drier climate => higher need
  // weighted blend (weights sum to 1). Aquifer + soil dominate per the science, but a dry
  // climate raises the value of recharge everywhere (the need term lifts arid regions).
  const base=aqf*0.30+soil*0.20+sl*0.18+fa*0.17+ (0.15*0.5);
  // need amplifies the whole score (drought regions get a real, science-based boost)
  return clamp(base*(0.82+need*0.33),0,1);
}

function earthlineClaimPath(mask,pts,r){

    const gx=Math.round(px),gy=Math.round(py);
    for(let oy=-r;oy<=r;oy++)for(let ox=-r;ox<=r;ox++){

      if(nx>=0&&ny>=0&&nx<GW&&ny<GH)mask[idx(nx,ny)]=1;
    }
  }
}

function earthlinePathOverlap(mask,pts){
  if(!pts.length)return 1;
  let hit=0;
  for(const [px,py] of pts){
    const gx=Math.round(px),gy=Math.round(py);
    if(gx>=0&&gy>=0&&gx<GW&&gy<GH&&mask[idx(gx,gy)])hit++;
  }
  return hit/pts.length;
}

function earthlineCleanPath(pts){
  if(!pts||pts.length<3)return pts||[];
  const out=[];
  let last=null;
  for(const p of pts){
    if(!last||Math.hypot(p[0]-last[0],p[1]-last[1])>0.08){out.push(p);last=p;}
  }
  if(out.length<3)return out;
  const sm=[out[0]];
  for(let i=1;i<out.length-1;i++){
    const p0=out[i-1],p=out[i],p1=out[i+1];
    sm.push([(p0[0]+2*p[0]+p1[0])/4,(p0[1]+2*p[1]+p1[1])/4]);
  }
  sm.push(out[out.length-1]);
  return sm;
}


// Engineering setback assumptions for screening only. These are intentionally conservative,
// because an infiltration swale too close to a foundation, driveway, or road can create
// seepage, frost-heave, shoulder, and access issues. Final construction still needs local
// engineering, utilities, septic, well, and right-of-way review.
const EARTHLINE_SETBACK_M={
  structure:10.0,      // ~33 ft screening buffer from confirmed buildings/foundations
  pavedEdge:7.0,       // ~23 ft planning buffer from confirmed road/driveway/pavement edge
  minimum:3.5          // never less than ~11.5 ft from confirmed hard surface
};







function earthlineSegmentLengthM(pts){
  if(!pts||pts.length<2)return 0;
  let d=0;
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++)d+=Math.hypot(pts[i][0]-pts[i-1][0],pts[i][1]-pts[i-1][1])*M.cellM;
  return d;
}

/* BUILD-CHECK-15768
   Minimum corridor length is a physical screening threshold, not an uncapped
   multiple of regional raster-cell size. This keeps property and regional
   analyses on the same real-world rule without requiring hundreds of metres
   of uninterrupted contour at coarse tile resolution. */
function earthlineMinimumSwaleLengthM15768(){
  const cell=Math.max(0.25,Number(M.cellM||1));
  return Math.max(12,Math.min(40,cell*4));
}

function earthlineSplitUsableSegments(pts,maxS){
  // Split a contour wherever it touches a no-build setback. This avoids drawing across or
  // immediately beside roofs, roads, and driveways while preserving longer buildable contours.
  const segs=[];
  let cur=[];
  const minM=earthlineMinimumSwaleLengthM15768(); // physical 12–40 m corridor-length threshold
  let prev=null;
  for(const p of (pts||[])){
    // Check the actual line between vertices, not only the vertices. This prevents a smoothed
    // swale from visually crossing a narrow driveway/roof between sampled points.
    let ok=earthlinePathPointUsable(p[0],p[1],maxS);
    if(ok&&prev){
      const steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(p[0]-prev[0],p[1]-prev[1])*2));
      for(let k=1;k<steps;k++){
        const t=k/steps;
        if(!earthlinePathPointUsable(prev[0]+(p[0]-prev[0])*t,prev[1]+(p[1]-prev[1])*t,maxS)){ok=false;break;}
      }
    }
    if(ok)cur.push(p);
    else{
      if(earthlineSegmentLengthM(cur)>=minM)segs.push(earthlineCleanPath(cur));
      cur=[];
    }
    prev=p;
  }
  if(earthlineSegmentLengthM(cur)>=minM)segs.push(earthlineCleanPath(cur));
  segs.sort((a,b)=>earthlineSegmentLengthM(b)-earthlineSegmentLengthM(a));
  return segs;
}


function earthlineVecUnit(ax,ay,bx,by){
  const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,m=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
  return [dx/m,dy/m];
}

function earthlineBridgeUsable(a,b,maxS){
  const gapCells=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);
  const steps=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(gapCells*2.5));
  for(let k=1;k<steps;k++){
    const t=k/steps;
    if(!earthlinePathPointUsable(a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*t,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t,maxS))return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function earthlineJoinPathsIfCompatible(a,b,maxS,maxGapM){
  if(!a||!b||a.length<2||b.length<2)return null;
  const variants=[
    [a,b],
    [a,b.slice().reverse()],
    [a.slice().reverse(),b],
    [a.slice().reverse(),b.slice().reverse()]
  ];
  let best=null;
  for(const pair of variants){
    const pa=pair[0],pb=pair[1],ae=pa[pa.length-1],bs=pb[0];
    const gapM=Math.hypot(bs[0]-ae[0],bs[1]-ae[1])*M.cellM;
    if(gapM>maxGapM)continue;
    const ta=earthlineVecUnit(pa[pa.length-2][0],pa[pa.length-2][1],ae[0],ae[1]);
    const tb=earthlineVecUnit(bs[0],bs[1],pb[1][0],pb[1][1]);
    const bridge=earthlineVecUnit(ae[0],ae[1],bs[0],bs[1]);
    // A contour can curve, but a join should continue generally forward rather than
    // doubling back into a hook or connecting unrelated parallel lines.
    // 15624: a join must continue in the same general direction. The previous permissive
    // threshold allowed hook and near-90-degree connections that did not resemble a level swale.
    const minForward=gapM<=Math.max(2.5,M.cellM*2.5)?0.48:0.68;
    const aligned=earthlineDot2(ta,bridge)>minForward&&
      earthlineDot2(bridge,tb)>minForward&&earthlineDot2(ta,tb)>0.50;
    if(!aligned||!earthlineBridgeUsable(ae,bs,maxS))continue;
    const gapCells=Math.hypot(bs[0]-ae[0],bs[1]-ae[1]);
    const n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(gapCells));
    const bridgePts=[];
    for(let k=1;k<n;k++){
      const t=k/n;bridgePts.push([ae[0]+(bs[0]-ae[0])*t,ae[1]+(bs[1]-ae[1])*t]);
    }
    const joined=earthlineCleanPath(pa.concat(bridgePts,pb));
    const rank=gapM+(1-earthlineDot2(ta,tb))*2;
    if(!best||rank<best.rank)best={pts:joined,rank};
  }
  return best?best.pts:null;
}

  const maxGapM=Math.min(8,Math.max(4,targetM*0.65));
  for(let i=0;i<pool.length;i++){
    if(used[i])continue;
    used[i]=1;
    let current=pool[i],changed=true,passes=0;
    while(changed&&passes++<6){
      changed=false;let bestJ=-1,bestPts=null,bestLen=0;
      for(let j=0;j<pool.length;j++){
        if(used[j]||pool[j].band!==current.band)continue;
        const joined=earthlineJoinPathsIfCompatible(current.pts,pool[j].pts,maxS,maxGapM);
        if(!joined)continue;
        const len=earthlineSegmentLengthM(joined);
        if(len>bestLen){bestLen=len;bestJ=j;bestPts=joined;}
      }
      if(bestJ>=0){
        const other=pool[bestJ];
        const rebuilt=earthlineSwaleFromPts(bestPts,current.band,chanThr,current.isSite||other.isSite,maxS,totalBands);
        if(rebuilt){
          rebuilt.merged=true;
          current=rebuilt;used[bestJ]=1;changed=true;
        }
      }
    }
    out.push(current);
  }
  return out;
}

function earthlineSwaleGeometryAcceptable(pts,lenM){
  if(!pts||pts.length<3||lenM<12)return false;
  const a=pts[0],b=pts[pts.length-1],gapM=Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1])*M.cellM;
  let minX=Infinity,maxX=-Infinity,minY=Infinity,maxY=-Infinity;
  for(const p of pts){minX=Math.min(minX,p[0]);maxX=Math.max(maxX,p[0]);minY=Math.min(minY,p[1]);maxY=Math.max(maxY,p[1]);}
  const diagM=Math.hypot(maxX-minX,maxY-minY)*M.cellM;
  const loopish=gapM<Math.max(8,lenM*0.12);
  // Suppress small closed rings and compact bullseyes caused by neighborhood/DEM artifacts.
  if(loopish&&(lenM<240||lenM/Math.max(1,diagM)>3.2))return false;
  if(lenM/Math.max(1,diagM)>6)return false;
  return true;
}

  if(earthlineCaptureVisitToken16455===0){earthlineCaptureVisitMark16455.fill(0);earthlineCaptureVisitToken16455=1;}
  return earthlineCaptureVisitToken16455;
}
function earthlineSwaleFromPts(pts,bandIndex,chanThr,isSite,maxS,totalBands){

              + impRunoffScore*0.09 + lenScore*0.08 + siteBonus) * forestPenalty * impOnPenalty;

  };
}


function traceLevelContour(sx,sy,L,maxS,dropH){
  const start=earthlineNearestContourCell(sx,sy,L,maxS);
  if(!start)return [];

  const cross=(ha,hb)=>{
    const d=hb-ha;
    if(Math.abs(d)<1e-9)return 0.5;
    return clamp((L-ha)/d,0,1);
  };

  const edgesFor=(cx,cy)=>{
    if(cx<0||cy<0||cx>=GW-1||cy>=GH-1)return [];
    const h00=M.h[idx(cx,cy)],h10=M.h[idx(cx+1,cy)],
          h01=M.h[idx(cx,cy+1)],h11=M.h[idx(cx+1,cy+1)];
    const e=[];
    if((h00<=L)!==(h10<=L))e.push([0,cx+cross(h00,h10),cy]);
    if((h10<=L)!==(h11<=L))e.push([1,cx+1,cy+cross(h10,h11)]);
    if((h01<=L)!==(h11<=L))e.push([2,cx+cross(h01,h11),cy+1]);
    if((h00<=L)!==(h01<=L))e.push([3,cx,cy+cross(h00,h01)]);
    return e;
  };

  const walk=(firstPick)=>{
    const pts=[];
    let cx=start[0],cy=start[1],prevEdge=-1;
    const visited=new Set();

    for(let step=0;step<1600;step++){
      if(!earthlineSafeCell(cx,cy,maxS))break;

      const key=cx+","+cy+","+prevEdge;
      if(visited.has(key))break;
      visited.add(key);

      const edges=edgesFor(cx,cy);
      if(edges.length===0)break;

      let candidates=prevEdge>=0?edges.filter(e=>e[0]!==prevEdge):edges;
      if(!candidates.length)candidates=edges;

      const pick=(step===0)?candidates[firstPick%candidates.length]:candidates[0];
      pts.push([pick[1],pick[2]]);

      let nx=cx,ny=cy,entered=-1;
      if(pick[0]===0){ny=cy-1;entered=2;}
      else if(pick[0]===1){nx=cx+1;entered=3;}
      else if(pick[0]===2){ny=cy+1;entered=0;}
      else{nx=cx-1;entered=1;}

      cx=nx;cy=ny;prevEdge=entered;
    }

    return pts;
  };

  const a=walk(0),b=walk(1);
  const merged=a.slice().reverse().concat(b);
  if(merged.length<3)return [];

  return earthlineCleanPath(merged);
}

function soilPercScore(pts){
  if(!_soilData)return 0.6;                      // neutral when soil layer not loaded
  let sum=0,nn=0;
  for(const[px,py] of pts){
    const v=soilPercAt(Math.round(px),Math.round(py));
    if(v>=0){sum+=v;nn++;}
  }
  return nn?sum/nn:0.6;
}

function traceContour(sx,sy,chanThr,maxS){
  const half=(dirSign)=>{
    const pts=[];
    let x=sx,y=sy,px=0,pyv=0;
    let crossed=0;
    for(let step=0;step<90;step++){
      const[gx,gy]=gradAt(Math.round(x),Math.round(y));
      const mag=Math.hypot(gx,gy);
      if(mag<1e-7)break;
      let dx=-gy/mag*dirSign*0.85,dy=gx/mag*dirSign*0.85; // smaller step = smoother
      if(step>0&&(dx*px+dy*pyv)<0){dx=-dx;dy=-dy;}
      px=dx;pyv=dy;
      x+=dx;y+=dy;
      const gxi=Math.round(x),gyi=Math.round(y);
      if(gxi<2||gyi<2||gxi>=GW-2||gyi>=GH-2)break;
      const i=idx(gxi,gyi);
      if(!M.inP[i])break;
      const sp=slopePct(gxi,gyi);
      if(sp>maxS+3)break;            // relaxed slope ceiling for noisy real DEM
      if(M.acc[i]>=chanThr){          // allow crossing a minor channel, stop at a big one
        if(++crossed>3)break;
      }
      pts.push([x,y]);
    }
    return pts;
  };
  const a=half(1),b=half(-1);
  b.reverse();
  b.push([sx,sy]);
  return b.concat(a);
}

function currentMapBBox(){
  const halfW=GW*M.cellM/2, halfH=GH*M.cellM/2;
  const dLat=halfH/111320;
  const dLng=halfW/(111320*Math.cos(M.centerLat*Math.PI/180));
  return {minLng:M.centerLng-dLng,maxLng:M.centerLng+dLng,minLat:M.centerLat-dLat,maxLat:M.centerLat+dLat};
}
function lngLatToGrid(lng,lat){
  const dxM=(lng-M.centerLng)*(111320*Math.cos(M.centerLat*Math.PI/180));
  const dyM=(lat-M.centerLat)*111320;
  return [GW/2+dxM/M.cellM, GH/2-dyM/M.cellM];
}
// ===== NRCS SSURGO soil perc data (real, no key) =====
// Hydrologic Soil Group -> perc suitability for swales (0..1). Mid perc is best:
// A (sandy, very fast) drains too fast to hold water; D (clay, very slow) won't infiltrate.
let _soilData=null,_soilW=0,_soilH=0;            // rasterized perc grid over the analysis window
const HSG_PERC={A:0.55,B:0.95,C:0.80,D:0.40};    // B/C loams = ideal swale ground
function soilPercAt(gx,gy){
  if(!_soilData)return -1;
  if(gx<0||gy<0||gx>=GW||gy>=GH)return -1;
  const sx=Math.round((gx/GW)*_soilW), sy=Math.round((gy/GH)*_soilH);
  if(sx<0||sy<0||sx>=_soilW||sy>=_soilH)return -1;
  const v=_soilData[sy*_soilW+sx];
  return v>0?v:-1;                                // 0 = no data
}

async function fetchHSG(mukeys){

  try{

    const q="select mu.mukey, c.hydgrp from mapunit mu "
      +"join component c on c.mukey=mu.mukey "
      +"where mu.mukey in ("+list+") and c.majcompflag='Yes'";
    const r=await fetch("https://sdmdataaccess.nrcs.usda.gov/Tabular/post.rest",{
      method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
      body:JSON.stringify({query:q,format:"JSON"})});
    if(r.ok){
      const j=await r.json();
      (j.Table||[]).forEach(row=>{const mk=row[0],hg=(row[1]||"").charAt(0);if(hg&&!map[mk])map[mk]=hg;});
    }
  }catch(e){}
  return map;
}
function rasterizeSoils(rows,hsgMap){
  // burn mapunit polygons into a perc grid using an offscreen canvas
  _soilW=GW;_soilH=GH;
  const cv=document.createElement("canvas");cv.width=GW;cv.height=GH;
  const g=cv.getContext("2d");
  g.clearRect(0,0,GW,GH);
  let any=false;
  rows.forEach(rw=>{
    const mukey=rw[0], wkt=rw[1];
    if(!wkt)return;
    const hsg=hsgMap[mukey]||"C";
    const perc=HSG_PERC[hsg]!=null?HSG_PERC[hsg]:0.7;
    // encode perc 0..1 into the red channel 1..255 (0 reserved = no data)
    const enc=Math.max(1,Math.round(perc*255));
    g.fillStyle="rgb("+enc+",0,0)";
    parseWKTPolygons(wkt).forEach(ring=>{
      if(ring.length<3)return;any=true;
      g.beginPath();
      ring.forEach((c,i)=>{const[gx,gy]=lngLatToGrid(c[0],c[1]);i?g.lineTo(gx,gy):g.moveTo(gx,gy);});
      g.closePath();g.fill();
    });
  });
  if(!any){_soilData=null;return;}
  const im=g.getImageData(0,0,GW,GH).data;
  _soilData=new Float32Array(GW*GH);
  for(let i=0,q=0;i<im.length;i+=4,q++) _soilData[q]=im[i]/255;   // decode perc back to 0..1
}
function parseWKTPolygons(wkt){
  // minimal WKT POLYGON / MULTIPOLYGON ring extractor -> array of [ [lng,lat], ... ]
  const rings=[];
  const re=/\(([-0-9.,\s]+)\)/g;let m;
  while((m=re.exec(wkt))){
    const pts=m[1].trim().split(",").map(pr=>{
      const xy=pr.trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number);
      return [xy[0],xy[1]];
    }).filter(p=>p.length===2&&!isNaN(p[0])&&!isNaN(p[1]));
    if(pts.length>=3)rings.push(pts);
  }
  return rings;
}

function rasterizeSoils(rows,hsgMap){
  // burn mapunit polygons into a perc grid using an offscreen canvas
  _soilW=GW;_soilH=GH;
  const cv=document.createElement("canvas");cv.width=GW;cv.height=GH;
  const g=cv.getContext("2d");
  g.clearRect(0,0,GW,GH);
  let any=false;
  rows.forEach(rw=>{
    const mukey=rw[0], wkt=rw[1];
    if(!wkt)return;
    const hsg=hsgMap[mukey]||"C";
    const perc=HSG_PERC[hsg]!=null?HSG_PERC[hsg]:0.7;
    // encode perc 0..1 into the red channel 1..255 (0 reserved = no data)
    const enc=Math.max(1,Math.round(perc*255));
    g.fillStyle="rgb("+enc+",0,0)";
    parseWKTPolygons(wkt).forEach(ring=>{
      if(ring.length<3)return;any=true;
      g.beginPath();
      ring.forEach((c,i)=>{const[gx,gy]=lngLatToGrid(c[0],c[1]);i?g.lineTo(gx,gy):g.moveTo(gx,gy);});
      g.closePath();g.fill();
    });
  });
  if(!any){_soilData=null;return;}
  const im=g.getImageData(0,0,GW,GH).data;
  _soilData=new Float32Array(GW*GH);
  for(let i=0,q=0;i<im.length;i+=4,q++) _soilData[q]=im[i]/255;   // decode perc back to 0..1
}
function parseWKTPolygons(wkt){
  // minimal WKT POLYGON / MULTIPOLYGON ring extractor -> array of [ [lng,lat], ... ]
  const rings=[];
  const re=/\(([-0-9.,\s]+)\)/g;let m;
  while((m=re.exec(wkt))){
    const pts=m[1].trim().split(",").map(pr=>{
      const xy=pr.trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number);
      return [xy[0],xy[1]];
    }).filter(p=>p.length===2&&!isNaN(p[0])&&!isNaN(p[1]));
    if(pts.length>=3)rings.push(pts);
  }
  return rings;
}
// Rock-type -> relative permeability/recharge value (per USGS Ground Water Atlas classes).
// Sand & gravel and karst carbonate transmit water fastest; igneous/metamorphic slowest.
function aquiferPermFromName(name){
  const n=(name||"").toLowerCase();
  if(n.includes("sand and gravel")||n.includes("sand & gravel")||n.includes("basin-fill")||n.includes("allu",0))return 1.0;
  if(n.includes("carbonate")||n.includes("karst")||n.includes("limestone")||n.includes("dolomite"))return 0.92;
  if(n.includes("semiconsolidated")||n.includes("semi-consolidated"))return 0.8;
  if(n.includes("sandstone"))return 0.72;
  if(n.includes("basalt")||n.includes("volcanic"))return 0.6;
  if(n.includes("igneous")||n.includes("metamorphic")||n.includes("crystalline"))return 0.4;
  return 0.7;   // unknown principal aquifer = moderately permeable by default
}

function rampColor(t){
  const stops=[[0,[26,35,22]],[0.3,[54,60,35]],[0.52,[86,71,44]],[0.72,[120,99,62]],[0.88,[154,133,91]],[1,[198,180,140]]];
  for(let i=1;i<stops.length;i++){
    if(t<=stops[i][0]){
      const[t0,c0]=stops[i-1],[t1,c1]=stops[i];
      const f=(t-t0)/(t1-t0);
      return[c0[0]+(c1[0]-c0[0])*f,c0[1]+(c1[1]-c0[1])*f,c0[2]+(c1[2]-c0[2])*f];
    }
  }
  return stops[5][1];
}

function earthlineContourLabelClear(x,y,placed,minDist){

function drawContours(){
  // BUILD-CHECK-15760: balanced elevation visibility. 15697 proved the contours can be
  // restored, but it over-labeled the map. This version keeps the elevation lines clearly
  // visible while throttling labels so they explain the terrain instead of burying swales.
  const range=M.maxH-M.minH||1;
  const levels=18; // BUILD-CHECK-15760: fewer readable elevation bands; avoid white-line clutter.
  contourLabels.length=0;
  const placed=[];
  const minLabelDist=Math.max(130,Math.min(190,165*Math.max(0.86,view.s/5)));
  ctx.save();
  ctx.lineCap="round";ctx.lineJoin="round";
  for(let li=1;li<levels;li++){
    const L=M.minH+range*li/levels;
    const major=li%4===0;
    ctx.beginPath();
    let segCount=0;
    for(let y=0;y<GH-1;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW-1;x++){
      const h00=M.h[idx(x,y)],h10=M.h[idx(x+1,y)],h01=M.h[idx(x,y+1)],h11=M.h[idx(x+1,y+1)];
      if(!Number.isFinite(h00+h10+h01+h11))continue;
      let c=0;
      if(h00>L)c|=1;if(h10>L)c|=2;if(h11>L)c|=4;if(h01>L)c|=8;
      if(c===0||c===15)continue;
      const pts=[];
      const lerp=(a,b)=>{const den=b-a;return Math.abs(den)<1e-9?0.5:(L-a)/den;};
      if((c&1)!==((c&2)>>1))pts.push([x+lerp(h00,h10),y]);
      if(((c&2)>>1)!==((c&4)>>2))pts.push([x+1,y+lerp(h10,h11)]);
      if(((c&8)>>3)!==((c&4)>>2))pts.push([x+lerp(h01,h11),y+1]);
      if((c&1)!==((c&8)>>3))pts.push([x,y+lerp(h00,h01)]);
      if(pts.length>=2){
        const[ax,ay]=G2S(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]),[bx,by]=G2S(pts[1][0],pts[1][1]);
        ctx.moveTo(ax,ay);ctx.lineTo(bx,by);
        segCount++;
        // Labels only on major contours, spaced by both segment count and screen distance.
        if(major&&segCount%35===0&&earthlineContourLabelClear(ax,ay,placed,minLabelDist)){
          contourLabels.push([ax,ay,L]);placed.push([ax,ay]);
        }
        if(pts.length===4){
          const[cx2,cy2]=G2S(pts[2][0],pts[2][1]),[dx2,dy2]=G2S(pts[3][0],pts[3][1]);
          ctx.moveTo(cx2,cy2);ctx.lineTo(dx2,dy2);
        }
      }
    }
    if(segCount){
      // Clear linework with a restrained halo. 15697 was readable but too dominant.
      ctx.strokeStyle=major?"rgba(0,5,12,0.72)":"rgba(0,6,14,0.42)";
      ctx.lineWidth=major?4.2:2.1;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle=major?"rgba(255,255,255,0.82)":"rgba(222,242,255,0.38)";
      ctx.lineWidth=major?1.65:0.72;
      ctx.stroke();
      if(major){
        ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(110,220,255,0.42)";
        ctx.lineWidth=0.48;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }
  // Elevation labels in real feet. Throttled and collision-checked to avoid label walls.
  ctx.font="850 12.5px Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.textBaseline="middle";
  for(const[lx,ly,L]of contourLabels){
    const baseElev=Number.isFinite(Number(M.loc&&M.loc.elevM))?Number(M.loc.elevM):0;
    if(!Number.isFinite(L))continue;
    const feet=Math.round((baseElev+L)*3.28084/10)*10;
    if(!Number.isFinite(feet))continue;
    const ft=fmt(feet)+" ft";
    if(/nan|undefined|null/i.test(ft))continue;
    const tw=ctx.measureText(ft).width;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(2,7,14,0.86)";
    ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.76)";
    ctx.lineWidth=1.1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    if(typeof ctx.roundRect==="function")ctx.roundRect(lx-tw/2-7,ly-10,tw+14,20,5);
    else ctx.rect(lx-tw/2-7,ly-10,tw+14,20);
    ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.98)";
    ctx.fillText(ft,lx,ly+0.4);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function earthlineContourLabelClear(x,y,placed,minDist){
  for(const p of placed){
    const dx=x-p[0],dy=y-p[1];
    if(dx*dx+dy*dy<minDist*minDist)return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function drawContours(){
  // BUILD-CHECK-15760: balanced elevation visibility. 15697 proved the contours can be
  // restored, but it over-labeled the map. This version keeps the elevation lines clearly
  // visible while throttling labels so they explain the terrain instead of burying swales.
  const range=M.maxH-M.minH||1;
  const levels=18; // BUILD-CHECK-15760: fewer readable elevation bands; avoid white-line clutter.
  contourLabels.length=0;
  const placed=[];
  const minLabelDist=Math.max(130,Math.min(190,165*Math.max(0.86,view.s/5)));
  ctx.save();
  ctx.lineCap="round";ctx.lineJoin="round";
  for(let li=1;li<levels;li++){
    const L=M.minH+range*li/levels;
    const major=li%4===0;
    ctx.beginPath();
    let segCount=0;
    for(let y=0;y<GH-1;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW-1;x++){
      const h00=M.h[idx(x,y)],h10=M.h[idx(x+1,y)],h01=M.h[idx(x,y+1)],h11=M.h[idx(x+1,y+1)];
      if(!Number.isFinite(h00+h10+h01+h11))continue;
      let c=0;
      if(h00>L)c|=1;if(h10>L)c|=2;if(h11>L)c|=4;if(h01>L)c|=8;
      if(c===0||c===15)continue;
      const pts=[];
      const lerp=(a,b)=>{const den=b-a;return Math.abs(den)<1e-9?0.5:(L-a)/den;};
      if((c&1)!==((c&2)>>1))pts.push([x+lerp(h00,h10),y]);
      if(((c&2)>>1)!==((c&4)>>2))pts.push([x+1,y+lerp(h10,h11)]);
      if(((c&8)>>3)!==((c&4)>>2))pts.push([x+lerp(h01,h11),y+1]);
      if((c&1)!==((c&8)>>3))pts.push([x,y+lerp(h00,h01)]);
      if(pts.length>=2){
        const[ax,ay]=G2S(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]),[bx,by]=G2S(pts[1][0],pts[1][1]);
        ctx.moveTo(ax,ay);ctx.lineTo(bx,by);
        segCount++;
        // Labels only on major contours, spaced by both segment count and screen distance.
        if(major&&segCount%35===0&&earthlineContourLabelClear(ax,ay,placed,minLabelDist)){
          contourLabels.push([ax,ay,L]);placed.push([ax,ay]);
        }
        if(pts.length===4){
          const[cx2,cy2]=G2S(pts[2][0],pts[2][1]),[dx2,dy2]=G2S(pts[3][0],pts[3][1]);
          ctx.moveTo(cx2,cy2);ctx.lineTo(dx2,dy2);
        }
      }
    }
    if(segCount){
      // Clear linework with a restrained halo. 15697 was readable but too dominant.
      ctx.strokeStyle=major?"rgba(0,5,12,0.72)":"rgba(0,6,14,0.42)";
      ctx.lineWidth=major?4.2:2.1;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle=major?"rgba(255,255,255,0.82)":"rgba(222,242,255,0.38)";
      ctx.lineWidth=major?1.65:0.72;
      ctx.stroke();
      if(major){
        ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(110,220,255,0.42)";
        ctx.lineWidth=0.48;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }
  // Elevation labels in real feet. Throttled and collision-checked to avoid label walls.
  ctx.font="850 12.5px Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.textBaseline="middle";
  for(const[lx,ly,L]of contourLabels){
    const baseElev=Number.isFinite(Number(M.loc&&M.loc.elevM))?Number(M.loc.elevM):0;
    if(!Number.isFinite(L))continue;
    const feet=Math.round((baseElev+L)*3.28084/10)*10;
    if(!Number.isFinite(feet))continue;
    const ft=fmt(feet)+" ft";
    if(/nan|undefined|null/i.test(ft))continue;
    const tw=ctx.measureText(ft).width;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(2,7,14,0.86)";
    ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.76)";
    ctx.lineWidth=1.1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    if(typeof ctx.roundRect==="function")ctx.roundRect(lx-tw/2-7,ly-10,tw+14,20,5);
    else ctx.rect(lx-tw/2-7,ly-10,tw+14,20);
    ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.98)";
    ctx.fillText(ft,lx,ly+0.4);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawContourTopOverlay(){

  // elevation system visible above other overlays without covering recharge targets.
  const range=M.maxH-M.minH||1;
  const levels=18;
  ctx.save();

  for(let li=1;li<levels;li++){
    const major=li%4===0;
    if(!major)continue;
    const L=M.minH+range*li/levels;
    ctx.beginPath();
    let segCount=0;
    for(let y=0;y<GH-1;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW-1;x++){
      const h00=M.h[idx(x,y)],h10=M.h[idx(x+1,y)],h01=M.h[idx(x,y+1)],h11=M.h[idx(x+1,y+1)];
      if(!Number.isFinite(h00+h10+h01+h11))continue;
      let c=0;
      if(h00>L)c|=1;if(h10>L)c|=2;if(h11>L)c|=4;if(h01>L)c|=8;
      if(c===0||c===15)continue;
      const pts=[];
      const lerp=(a,b)=>{const den=b-a;return Math.abs(den)<1e-9?0.5:(L-a)/den;};
      if((c&1)!==((c&2)>>1))pts.push([x+lerp(h00,h10),y]);
      if(((c&2)>>1)!==((c&4)>>2))pts.push([x+1,y+lerp(h10,h11)]);
      if(((c&8)>>3)!==((c&4)>>2))pts.push([x+lerp(h01,h11),y+1]);
      if((c&1)!==((c&8)>>3))pts.push([x,y+lerp(h00,h01)]);
      if(pts.length>=2){
        const[ax,ay]=G2S(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]),[bx,by]=G2S(pts[1][0],pts[1][1]);
        ctx.moveTo(ax,ay);ctx.lineTo(bx,by);segCount++;
        if(pts.length===4){
          const[cx2,cy2]=G2S(pts[2][0],pts[2][1]),[dx2,dy2]=G2S(pts[3][0],pts[3][1]);

        }

      ctx.lineWidth=0.32;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
function flowStyle(a,thr){
  // BUILD-CHECK-15760: blue water movement must read above contours, recharge and swales.
  const t=clamp(Math.log(a/thr+1)/Math.log(M.maxAcc/thr+1),0,1);
  const w=(1.7+t*5.8)*Math.max(0.78,view.s/5);
  let col;
  if(t<0.33)col="rgba(46,190,255,"+(0.78+t*0.45)+")";
  else if(t<0.66)col="rgba(34,198,255,0.98)";
  else col="rgba(138,241,255,1)";
  return{w,col,t};
}
function drawFlow(thr){
  ctx.save();ctx.lineCap="round";ctx.lineJoin="round";

  // BUILD-CHECK-15672: extract fewer, longer, terrain-supported channels. D8 remains the
  // routing model, but short raster branches are pruned and each display point is shifted
  // within its DEM cell toward the local valley low before restrained curve smoothing.
  const active=new Uint8Array(N);
  const upstreamCount=new Uint8Array(N);
  const displayThr=Math.max(2,thr*0.78);
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    const i=idx(x,y);
    if(M.acc[i]>=displayThr&&(!M.inP||M.inP[i]))active[i]=1;
  }
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    const i=idx(x,y);if(!active[i])continue;
    const d=M.dir[i];if(d<0)continue;
    const nx=x+D8X[d],ny=y+D8Y[d];
    if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)continue;
    const ni=idx(nx,ny);if(active[ni]&&upstreamCount[ni]<255)upstreamCount[ni]++;
  }

  const valleyPoint=(x,y,d)=>{
    if(d<0)return [x+0.5,y+0.5];
    const vx=D8X[d],vy=D8Y[d],mag=Math.hypot(vx,vy)||1;
    const px=-vy/mag,py=vx/mag;
    let best=[x+0.5,y+0.5],bestH=hAt(best[0],best[1]);
    for(const off of [-0.42,-0.24,0,0.24,0.42]){
      const q=[x+0.5+px*off,y+0.5+py*off],hh=hAt(q[0],q[1]);
      if(hh<bestH){bestH=hh;best=q;}
    }
    return best;
  };
  const chaikin=(pts,passes)=>{
    let out=pts;
    for(let p=0;p<passes;p++){
      if(out.length<4)break;
      const q=[out[0]];
      for(let i=0;i<out.length-1;i++){
        const a=out[i],b=out[i+1];
        q.push([a[0]*0.72+b[0]*0.28,a[1]*0.72+b[1]*0.28]);
        q.push([a[0]*0.28+b[0]*0.72,a[1]*0.28+b[1]*0.72]);
      }
      q.push(out[out.length-1]);out=q;
    }
    return out;
  };
  const lineLengthCells=pts=>{
    let d=0;for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++)d+=Math.hypot(pts[i][0]-pts[i-1][0],pts[i][1]-pts[i-1][1]);return d;
  };

  const segments=[];
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    const start=idx(x,y);if(!active[start]||upstreamCount[start]===1)continue;
    const d0=M.dir[start];if(d0<0)continue;
    let cx=x,cy=y,ci=start,guard=0,maxA=M.acc[start];
    const pts=[valleyPoint(cx,cy,d0)];
    while(guard++<700){
      const d=M.dir[ci];if(d<0)break;
      const nx=cx+D8X[d],ny=cy+D8Y[d];
      if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=GW||ny>=GH)break;
      const ni=idx(nx,ny);if(!active[ni])break;
      cx=nx;cy=ny;ci=ni;maxA=Math.max(maxA,M.acc[ni]);
      pts.push(valleyPoint(cx,cy,M.dir[ci]));
      if(upstreamCount[ci]!==1)break;
    }
    const len=lineLengthCells(pts),strength=maxA/displayThr;
    // Remove short isolated twigs and low-confidence diagonal strokes.
    if(len<2.4&&strength<2.2)continue;
    if(len<1.8)continue;
    segments.push({pts,maxA,len,strength});
  }

  // Major channels first, then credible tributaries merging into them.
  segments.sort((a,b)=>a.maxA-b.maxA);
  for(const seg of segments){
    const st=flowStyle(seg.maxA,displayThr);
    const passes=seg.pts.length>12?3:(seg.pts.length>6?2:1);
    const pts=chaikin(seg.pts,passes);
    if(pts.length<2)continue;

    const trace=()=>{
      ctx.beginPath();
      const p0=G2S(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);ctx.moveTo(p0[0],p0[1]);
      if(pts.length===2){
        const p1=G2S(pts[1][0],pts[1][1]);ctx.line

--- function drawContours @ char 1072283 line 7557 ---
   sh=clamp(sh,0.1,0.95);
        const p=i*4;

      }
      hctx.putImageData(img,0,0);
      g.globalCompositeOperation="overlay";
      g.globalAlpha=0.85;
      g.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;
      g.drawImage(hs,0,0,840,584);
      g.globalAlpha=1;
      g.globalCompositeOperation="source-over";
    }
    if(M.layers.boundary.on&&M.boundary.length){
      g.fillStyle="rgba(3,6,11,0.5)";
      g.beginPath();
      g.rect(0,0,840,584);
      const sx=840/GW, sy=584/GH;
      M.boundary.forEach((p,i)=>{const X=p[0]*sx,Y=p[1]*sy;if(i===0)g.moveTo(X,Y);else g.lineTo(X,Y);});
      g.closePath();

    }

  }
  const off=document.createElement("canvas");off.width=GW;off.height=GH;
  const octx=off.getContext("2d");
  const img=octx.createImageData(GW,GH);
  const d=img.data,range=M.maxH-M.minH||1;
  const exag=M.exag3d?2.4:1.5;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    const i=idx(x,y),t=(M.h[i]-M.minH)/range;
    let r,g,b;
    if(M.layers.satellite.on){const c=rampColor(t);r=c[0];g=c[1];b=c[2];}
    else{r=g=b=46+t*120;}
    if(M.layers.hillshade.on){
      const x1=clamp(x+1,0,GW-1),y1=clamp(y+1,0,GH-1);
      const sh=clamp(0.66+(M.h[i]-M.h[idx(x1,y)])*exag*1.15/M.cellM+(M.h[i]-M.h[idx(x,y1)])*exag*0.85/M.cellM,0.22,1.32);
      r*=sh;g*=sh;b*=sh;
    }
    if(M.layers.boundary.on&&!M.inP[i]){r*=0.45;g*=0.45;b*=0.45;}
    const p=i*4;d[p]=r;d[p+1]=g;d[p+2]=b;d[p+3]=255;
  }
  octx.putImageData(img,0,0);
  terrainImg=off;
}

function flowStyle(a,thr){

  const t=clamp(Math.log(a/thr+1)/Math.log(M.maxAcc/thr+1),0,1);

}

// REGIONAL PRIORITY ZONES (zoomed-out view) — where is swale work highest-impact?
// At regional/national scale individual swales are sub-pixel, so instead we surface the
// AREAS where slowing/spreading/sinking water matters most: places that combine
// concentrated runoff, workable terrain (not cliffs), and water stress / recharge need.
// This is an honest suitability surface, not fake individual swales.
function regionalPriorityAt(x,y){
  const i=idx(x,y);
  if(!M.inP[i])return 0;
  const fa=Math.log(M.acc[i]+1)/Math.log(M.maxAcc+1);     // concentrated runoff
  const sp=slopePct(x,y);
  const work=sp<=15?1:Math.max(0,1-(sp-15)/15);           // workable terrain (<~15%)
  const precip=(M.loc&&M.loc.precipIn)||30;
  const stress=clamp(1-(precip-8)/55,0.15,1);             // drier => more needed
  return fa*0.5*work + work*0.2*stress + fa*work*stress*0.3;
}

async function earthlineGenerateScreeningFallbackSwales(myGen=M.searchGen){
  if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
  console.warn("[Earthline] Live DEM produced no visible swales; running explicit screening fallback.");
  M.seed=hashStr((M.loc&&M.loc.name||"site")+"|"+M.zone+"|screening-fallback");
  buildTerrainProceduralWrap();
  buildBoundary();
  M.minH=Infinity;M.maxH=-Infinity;
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    if(M.h[i]<M.minH)M.minH=M.h[i];
    if(M.h[i]>M.maxH)M.maxH=M.h[i];
  }
  pitFill();
  if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
  flowRoute();
  computeRecharge();
  prescribeSwales();
  M.demSource="generated screening fallback (survey verification required)";
  M.realMode=false;
  M.demReady=true;
  M.analysisReady=true;
  return M.swales.length>0;
}

        .10*open+
        .12*channelSetback
      ));
      runoffSum+=runoff;

      if(baseScore>=42)candidates.push({
        gx:x,gy:y,levelH:hAt(x,y),slopePct:sp,
        baseScore,runoff:Number(runoff.toFixed(3)),open
      });
    }

    candidates.sort((a,b)=>b.baseScore-a.baseScore);
    const hotspots=[];
    for(const c of candidates){
      if(hotspots.length>=8)break;
      if(hotspots.some(h=>Math.hypot(h.gx-c.gx,h.gy-c.gy)<16))continue;

      const corridorResult=opportunityContourPath15777(tile,cellM,c);
      if(!corridorResult)continue;

      const finalScore=Math.round(
        .68*c.baseScore+
        .32*corridorResult.metrics.quality
      );
      const coord=gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,c.gx,c.gy);
      const confidence=(
        finalScore>=80 &&
        corridorResult.metrics.quality>=76 &&
        corridorResult.metrics.maxElevError<=1.6
      )?"High":(
        finalScore>=65 &&
        corridorResult.metrics.quality>=62
      )?"Moderate":"Preliminary";

      hotspots.push({
        tile:index,lng:coord[0],lat:coord[1],
        gx:c.gx,gy:c.gy,levelH:c.levelH,
        score:finalScore,
        slopePct:Number(c.slopePct.toFixed(1)),
        runoff:c.runoff,open:c.open,
        corridor:corridorResult.coords,
        pathMetrics:corridorResult.metrics,
        confidence
      });
    }

    const pct=n=>sampled?100*n/sampled:0;
    const rechargePct=Number(
      (M.rechargeStats&&(
        M.rechargeStats.highVeryHighPct!=null
          ?M.rechargeStats.highVeryHighPct
          :M.rechargeStats.modeledPotentialPct
      )) || ((M.donut||[]).slice(0,2).reduce((a,d)=>a+Number(d.p||0),0)) || 0
    );
    const idealPct=pct(ideal),workablePct=pct(workable),noBuildPct=pct(noBuild),canopyPct=pct(canopy);
    const runoffIndex=sampled?runoffSum/sampled:0;
    const tileScore=hotspots.length
      ?Math.round(hotspots.slice(0,4).reduce((a,h)=>a+h.score,0)/Math.min(4,hotspots.length))
      :0;

    return {
      tile:index,lat:tile.lat,lng:tile.lng,
      score:tileScore,
      idealSlopePct:Number(idealPct.toFixed(1)),
      workableSlopePct:Number(workablePct.toFixed(1)),
      noBuildPct:Number(noBuildPct.toFixed(1)),
      canopyPct:Number(canopyPct.toFixed(1)),
      runoffIndex:Number(runoffIndex.toFixed(4)),
      rechargePct:Number(rechargePct.toFixed(1)),
      sampledCells:sampled,
      hotspots
    };
  }

  function rebuildRegionalGrades15772(){

      }))

      }

      features.push({

  function rawSpacingSamples(raw){
    const nearest=[];
    for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++){
      let best=Infinity;
      const a=raw[i].coords||[],sa=Math.max(1,Math.floor(a.length/24));
      for(let j=0;j<raw.length;j++){
        if(i===j||raw[i].bandKey===raw[j].bandKey)continue;
        const b=raw[j].coords||[],sb=Math.max(1,Math.floor(b.length/24));
        for(let ai=0;ai<a.length;ai+=sa)for(let bi=0;bi<b.length;bi+=sb)best=Math.min(best,haversineM(a[ai],b[bi]));
      }
      if(Number.isFinite(best))nearest.push(best);
    }
    return nearest;
  }

        if(cross(h00,h10))pts.push([x+interp(h00,h10),y]);
        if(cross(h10,h11))pts.push([x+1,y+interp(h10,h11)]);
        if(cross(h01,h11))pts.push([x+interp(h01,h11),y+1]);
        if(cross(h00,h01))pts.push([x,y+interp(h00,h01)]);

        if(pts.length===2){
          const a=gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
          const b=gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,pts[1][0],pts[1][1]);
          lines.push([a,b]);
        }else if(pts.length===4){
          const a=gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
          const b=gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,pts[1][0],pts[1][1]);
          const c=gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,pts[2][0],pts[2][1]);
          const d=gridToLngLat(tile,cellM,pts[3][0],pts[3][1]);
          lines.push([a,b],[c,d]);
        }

        if(lines.length>=360)break;
      }

      if(!lines.length)continue;
      const major=levelIndex%2===0;
      features.push({
        type:"Feature",
        properties:{tile:tileIndex,major,elevM:Math.round(Number((M.loc&&M.loc.elevM)||0)+L)},
        geometry:{type:"MultiLineString",coordinates:lines}
      });

      if(major){
        const seg=lines[Math.floor(lines.length/2)];
        labelCoord=[(seg[0][0]+seg[1][0])/2,(seg[0][1]+seg[1][1])/2];
        const absM=Math.round(Number((M.loc&&M.loc.elevM)||0)+L);
        features.push({
          type:"Feature",
          properties:{tile:tileIndex,major:true,elevM:absM,label:absM.toLocaleString()+" m"},
          geometry:{type:"Point",coordinates:labelCoord}
        });
      }
    }
    return features;
  }

  function rawSpacingSamples(raw){
    const nearest=[];
    for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++){
      let best=Infinity;
      const a=raw[i].coords||[],sa=Math.max(1,Math.floor(a.length/24));
      for(let j=0;j<raw.length;j++){
        if(i===j||raw[i].bandKey===raw[j].bandKey)continue;
        const b=raw[j].coords||[],sb=Math.max(1,Math.floor(b.length/24));
        for(let ai=0;ai<a.length;ai+=sa)for(let bi=0;bi<b.length;bi+=sb)best=Math.min(best,haversineM(a[ai],b[bi]));
      }
      if(Number.isFinite(best))nearest.push(best);
    }
    return nearest;
  }

  function corridorLengthM15826(points){

  function nearestSwaleDistanceM15826(points){
    let best=Infinity;
    for(const point of points){
      for(const swale of M.swales||[]){
        const pts=swale&&swale.pts||[];
        for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){
          const ax=pts[i-1][0],ay=pts[i-1][1];
          const bx=pts[i][0],by=pts[i][1];
          const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay;
          const l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
          const t=l2>1e-12
            ?Math.max(
              0,
              Math.min(
                1,
                ((point[0]-ax)*dx+(point[1]-ay)*dy)/l2
              )
            )
            :0;
          best=Math.min(
            best,
            Math.hypot(
              point[0]-(ax+t*dx),
              point[1]-(ay+t*dy)
            )
          );
        }
      }
    }
    return best*Math.max(.001,Number(M.cellM||1));
  }
